note: 来自拉丁语 elevare ‘举起’，引申为‘提高、提升’

example_en: The microphone amplifies the speaker's voice.
example_zh: 麦克风放大了演讲者的声音。
note: 源自拉丁语 amplificare ‘扩大’，表示‘使声音、信号等增强’

example_en: The diamond had a tiny flaw that reduced its value.
example_zh: 这颗钻石有个微小瑕疵，降低了其价值。

example_en: Please check each item on the list before submitting.
example_zh: 请在提交前检查清单上的每一项。

example_en: The teacher marshaled the students into lines for the fire drill.
example_zh: 老师把学生整理成队伍进行消防演习。

example_en: The Earth is divided into northern and southern hemispheres.
example_zh: 地球被分为北半球和南半球。
note: 直译为‘半个球体’，常用于地理、天文学

example_en: She has a gentle and feminine manner.
example_zh: 她举止温柔，带有女性特质。
note: 源自拉丁语 femina ‘女人’，表示具有女性特征的

example_en: The team gained momentum after winning the first match.
example_zh: 团队在赢得第一场比赛后士气大增。
root: mov(移动) + -ment(名词后缀) + -um(名词后缀)
note: 源自拉丁语 momentum ‘运动’，物理上指‘质量×速度’，引申为‘发展势头’

example_en: The enemy attacked our flank during the battle.
example_zh: 战斗中，敌人袭击了我们的侧翼。

example_en: Penguins are flightless birds that live in Antarctica.
example_zh: 企鹅是不会飞的鸟类，栖息在南极洲。

example_en: Losing his job was a great misfortune for him.
example_zh: 失业对他来说是一个巨大的不幸。
note: 由 fortune ‘好运’ 加前缀 mis- 表示否定，意为‘坏运气、不幸’

example_en: Please give a brief summary of the report.
example_zh: 请简要总结一下这份报告。

example_en: The university granted her a scholarship for outstanding academic performance.
example_zh: 大学因她优秀的学术表现授予了她一项奖学金。

example_en: She joined the local environmental association to help protect the river.
example_zh: 她加入了当地的环保协会，以帮助保护这条河流。
root: assoc(靠近) + iat(做) + ion(名词后缀)
note: 靠近做事 → 联合组成组织

example_en: The technician repaired the damaged cable that supplied power to the building.
example_zh: 技术员修复了为大楼供电的损坏电缆。

example_en: This is an ideal opportunity to start your own business.
example_zh: 这是一个创办自己企业的理想时机。
note: 值得看的 → 完美无缺的

example_en: The government initiated a new policy to reduce carbon emissions.
example_zh: 政府发起了一项新政策以减少碳排放。
root: in-(向内) + initi(开始) + ate(动词后缀)
note: 向内开始 → 主动发起

example_en: He became cynical about politics after seeing so many broken promises.
example_zh: 看到太多食言后，他对政治变得愤世嫉俗。
note: 像狗一样刻薄 → 不信任人性

example_en: The company expended significant resources on research and development last year.
example_zh: 去年公司在研发上投入了大量资源。
note: 向外称重 → 花费资源

example_en: She had a productive morning, finishing three reports before lunch.
example_zh: 她上午工作很高效，午餐前就完成了三份报告。
note: 能生产出东西的 → 高效多产的

example_en: The training program is rigorous, requiring daily practice and strict discipline.
example_zh: 这个训练计划很严格，要求每天练习并保持严格纪律。
note: 像僵硬一样严苛 → 不容松懈

example_en: Years of hard work culminated in her winning the national award.
example_zh: 多年的努力工作 culminated 在她获得国家奖项。
note: 到达顶点 → 达到最高点

example_en: He complained about the noisy neighbors keeping him awake at night.
example_zh: 他抱怨邻居太吵，让他晚上无法入睡。
root: com-(加强) + plen(满) + ain(动词后缀)
note: 满怀不满 → 发出抱怨

example_en: She likes to tan on the beach during summer vacations.
example_zh: 她喜欢在夏季假期去海滩晒黑。

example_en: Astronomers observed a bright comet passing through the solar system last month.
example_zh: 上个月，天文学家观测到一颗明亮的彗星穿过太阳系。

example_en: The data was stored in a two-dimensional array for easy access.
example_zh: 数据被存储在一个二维数组中，以便轻松访问。
note: 向…排列 → 有序排列的一组

example_en: The magnet's north pole repels the north pole of another magnet.
example_zh: 磁铁的北极会排斥另一个磁铁的北极。

example_en: Children often lose themselves in fantasies of flying dragons and magic castles.
example_zh: 孩子们常常沉浸在关于飞龙和魔法城堡的幻想中。
note: 想象的事物 → 不真实的美好想象

example_en: She ascribes her success to hard work and perseverance.
example_zh: 她把自己的成功归因于努力工作和坚持不懈。
root: ad-(向) + scrib(写) + e(动词后缀)
note: 向…写上 → 认为…是由…造成的

example_en: The software package includes tools for editing, formatting, and printing documents.
example_zh: 这个软件包含用于编辑、格式化和打印文档的工具。
note: 打好的东西 → 一套完整的物品或服务

example_en: We chose ceramic tiles for the kitchen floor because they are durable and easy to clean.
example_zh: 我们选择了陶瓷瓷砖铺厨房地板，因为它们耐用且易于清洁。

example_en: Staying at a five-star resort is a luxury few can afford.
example_zh: 住在五星级度假村是少数人才能负担得起的奢侈。
note: 光亮的事物 → 奢华享受

example_en: Please don't interfere while I'm concentrating on this important task.
example_zh: 请不要在我专注处理这项重要任务时干扰我。

example_en: The majority of students passed the exam with scores above 80.
example_zh: 大多数学生考试成绩超过80分，顺利通过了考试。
note: 更大的部分 → 超过一半的部分

example_en: The institute conducts advanced research in artificial intelligence and robotics.
example_zh: 该研究所在人工智能和机器人领域进行前沿研究。
root: in-(向内) + stat(站) + ute(名词后缀)
note: 向内站立 → 建立机构进行固定工作

example_en: She went hiking despite the heavy rain and slippery trails.
example_zh: 尽管下着大雨且小路很滑，她仍然去徒步旅行。
note: 不顾蔑视 → 尽管有不利条件

example_en: The story features an imaginary kingdom where animals can talk and sing.
example_zh: 这个故事讲述了一个虚构的王国，在那里动物能说话和唱歌。
note: 想象中的 → 不存在的，虚构的

example_en: The manager will assign tasks to each team member.
example_zh: 经理将为每个团队成员分配任务。

example_en: The musician played a beautiful chord on the guitar.
example_zh: 音乐家在吉他上弹奏了一个美丽的和弦。

example_en: She defied the rules and did what she wanted.
example_zh: 她违抗规则，做了她想做的事。

example_en: The difficult terrain made it hard to climb the mountain.
example_zh: 艰难的地形使得攀登山变得很困难。

example_en: She is a diligent student and always finishes her homework on time.
example_zh: 她是一个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

example_en: The earthquake was a disaster for the city.
example_zh: 地震对这座城市来说是一场灾难。

example_en: The wealthy businessman donated a lot of money to charity.
example_zh: 富有的商人向慈善机构捐赠了很多钱。

example_en: The knight wore armor to protect himself in battle.
example_zh: 骑士穿着盔甲来保护自己在战斗中。

example_en: The company's sales began to slump after the recession.
example_zh: 公司的销售额在经济衰退后开始下滑。

example_en: The company will dispatch a team to fix the problem.
example_zh: 公司将派遣一队人员来解决这个问题。

example_en: The team took a break for refreshment before continuing the game.
example_zh: 球队在继续比赛前休息了一会儿。

example_en: He staggered out of the bar after drinking too much.
example_zh: 他在酒吧喝了太多酒后踉跄地走出来了。

example_en: One of her characteristic traits is her kindness.
example_zh: 她的一個特徵是她的善良。

example_en: The glare from the window made it hard to see the TV.
example_zh: 窗户的强光使得看电视很困难。

example_en: The boss dictated a letter to his secretary.
example_zh: 老板口述了一封信给他的秘书。

example_en: The company will incur a large debt if it doesn't reduce costs.
example_zh: 如果公司不减少成本，它将遭受巨大的债务。

example_en: Sulfur is a yellow chemical element.
example_zh: 硫是一种黄色的化学元素。

example_en: The city has a diverse ethnic population.
example_zh: 这座城市有多元的民族人口。

example_en: The government's repression of the protest was widely criticized.
example_zh: 政府对抗议的压制被广泛批评。

example_en: The introduction will precede the main speech.
example_zh: 介绍将先于主要演讲。

example_en: She is a cautious driver and always wears a seatbelt.
example_zh: 她是一个谨慎的驾驶员，总是系安全带。

example_en: The crowd became hysterical when the pop star appeared on stage.
example_zh: 人群在流行歌手出现在舞台上时变得歇斯底里。

example_en: The company will affiliate with a new partner next year.
example_zh: 公司将在明年与新合作伙伴隶属。

example_en: The pendulum swung back and forth in a steady rhythm.
example_zh: 钟摆以稳定的节奏来回摆动。

example_en: The threshold of the house was worn out from years of use.
example_zh: 房子的门槛由于多年的使用而磨损了。

example_en: The pupil will dilate in low light.
example_zh: 在低光环境下，瞳孔会扩张。

example_en: The incessant noise kept me awake all night.
example_zh: 不断的噪音让我整夜难眠。
root: in-(不) + cess-(停止) + ant-(形容词后缀)

example_en: The new policy is a boon to the local economy.
example_zh: 新政策是对当地经济的恩惠。

example_en: The temperate climate makes this place ideal for vacation.
example_zh: 温和的气候使这个地方成为理想的度假地。

example_en: Snakes and lizards are reptiles.
example_zh: 蛇和蜥蜴都是爬行动物。

example_en: The flora in the tropical rainforest is incredibly diverse.
example_zh: 热带雨林中的植物种类令人难以置信地多样。

example_en: Gin is a popular spirit in many cocktails.
example_zh: 杜松子酒是许多鸡尾酒中流行的烈酒。

example_en: Her stature and confidence made her stand out in the crowd.
example_zh: 她的身高和自信使她在人群中脱颖而出。

example_en: The doctor checked my blood pressure.
example_zh: 医生检查了我的血压。

example_en: The play was a farce, full of silly jokes and physical comedy.
example_zh: 这出戏是一部闹剧，充满了傻乎乎的笑话和身体喜剧。

example_en: Sloth is one of the seven deadly sins.
example_zh: 懒惰是七宗罪之一。

example_en: The study of anatomy is essential for medical students.
example_zh: 解剖学的研究对于医学生来说是必不可少的。

example_en: The incongruity between the two styles was striking.
example_zh: 两种风格之间的不协调非常显著。

example_en: The circuitous route took us through several small towns.
example_zh: 迂回的路线让我们途经了几个小镇。

example_en: She stashed the money in a safe place.
example_zh: 她把钱藏在一个安全的地方。

example_en: The journalist accused the politician of trying to pervert the truth.
example_zh: 记者指责政治家试图歪曲事实。

example_en: The news left me in a daze.
example_zh: 新闻让我感到恍惚。

example_zh: 支流流入了主河。

example_zh: 火山已经休眠了几个世纪。

example_zh: 视角缩短了距离。

example_en: The laws of physics are immutable.
example_zh: 物理定律是不可改变的。

example_en: The doleful music suited the mournful atmosphere.
example_zh: 悲伤的音乐适合哀伤的气氛。

example_en: After the traumatic event, she began to question her sanity.
example_zh: 在创伤事件之后，她开始质疑自己的理智。

example_en: The pueblo was a small village in the desert.
example_zh: 普韦布洛是一个沙漠中的小村庄。

example_zh: 他装腔作势地当专家很可笑。

example_en: The company will disburse the funds to the investors next month.
example_zh: 公司将在下个月向投资者支出资金。

example_en: She is an adaptable person who can work well in different environments.
example_zh: 她是一个适应性强的人，可以在不同的环境中工作得很好。

example_en: The country suffered under despotism for many years.
example_zh: 该国多年来受专制统治的折磨。
note: 通过词根联想为专制主义

example_en: The florescence of the cherry blossoms was a beautiful sight.
example_zh: 樱花的开花是一道美丽的景象。

example_en: The epithet 'the Great' was given to the king.
example_zh: 国王被赐予'大帝'的称号。
note: 通过词根联想为放在上的称号

example_en: He looked very dapper in his new suit.
example_zh: 他穿着新西装看起来非常整洁。

example_zh: 酷热使得工作变得困难。

example_en: She stored the food in the pantry.
example_zh: 她把食物存放在食品柜里。

example_en: He was diffident about his ability to speak in public.
example_zh: 他对自己的公开演讲能力缺乏自信。
note: 通过词根联想为不信任自己

example_en: She was an erstwhile friend of mine.
example_zh: 她曾经是我的朋友。
note: 通过词根联想为以前的期间

example_en: The refractory child refused to listen to his parents.
example_zh: 难以控制的孩子拒绝听父母的话。
note: 通过词根联想为再次破碎的性格

example_en: The insentient rock did not respond to the stimulus.
example_zh: 无感觉的岩石对刺激没有反应。
note: 通过词根联想为没有感觉的性质

example_en: She had a flaunty way of walking.
example_zh: 她有着张扬的走路方式。

example_en: The coronation ceremony was held in the cathedral.
example_zh: 加冕仪式在大教堂举行。
note: 通过词根联想为王冠的过程

example_en: The unprovoked attack caught everyone off guard.
example_zh: 无故的攻击让所有人措手不及。
note: 通过词根联想为没有挑衅的状态

example_en: The two wrestlers wrestled for the championship.
example_zh: 两名摔跤手为冠军而摔跤。

example_en: The student faced expulsion from school for cheating.
example_zh: 学生因作弊面临被学校开除的处罚。
note: 通过词根联想为被推出的过程

example_en: She felt a general malaise after the flu.
example_zh: 她在流感后感到一种不适。
note: 通过词根联想为坏的状态

example_en: The subterranean tunnel was used for transportation.
example_zh: 地下隧道被用作交通工具。
note: 通过词根联想为属于下面的地

example_en: The artist's eclectic style was a mix of different influences.
example_zh: 艺术家的折衷风格是不同影响的混合。
note: 通过词根联想为选择的性质

example_en: The squab was very cute and fluffy.
example_zh: 小鸭很可爱，羽毛也很蓬松。

example_en: The painter's artistry was evident in her beautiful works.
example_zh: 画家的艺术技巧在她的美丽作品中显现出来。
note: 通过词根联想为艺术技巧

example_en: The entrancing music made everyone want to dance.
example_zh: 迷人的音乐让所有人都想跳舞。
note: 通过词根联想为使入神的状态

example_en: The king's puissance was absolute in the kingdom.
example_zh: 国王在王国中的权力是绝对的。
note: 通过词根联想为能的状态

example_en: The hawker sold his goods on the street.
example_zh: 小贩在街上出售他的商品。

example_en: The couple was betrothed for two years before getting married.
example_zh: 这对夫妇在结婚前已经许配了两年。
note: 通过词根联想为使忠诚的状态

example_en: The lurid details of the crime were reported in the newspaper.
example_zh: 犯罪的耸人听闻的细节被报纸报道。
note: 通过词根联想为诱惑的性质

example_en: The conviviality of the gathering made everyone feel welcome.
example_zh: 聚会的友好热情让每个人都感到受欢迎。
note: 共同生活的状态，指人与人之间的和谐友好

example_en: The palmy days of the empire are long gone.
example_zh: 帝国繁荣的日子早已一去不复返。
note: 棕榈树茂盛象征繁荣，引申为兴旺发达

example_en: They sang a beautiful madrigal under the moonlight.
example_zh: 他们在月光下唱了一首优美的牧歌。
note: 源自意大利语，指无伴奏多声部合唱的世俗歌曲

example_en: The library is a cornucopia of knowledge for students.
example_zh: 图书馆是学生们知识的丰富宝库。
note: 拉丁语‘丰富之角’，希腊神话中充满水果的角，象征丰饶

example_en: We’ve made little headway in solving this problem.
example_zh: 我们在解决这个问题上几乎没有进展。
note: 原指船只前进的速度，引申为取得进展

example_en: Even during the crisis, she remained unflappable.
example_zh: 即使在危机中，她也始终镇定自若。
note: flappable来源于flap(拍打)，比喻惊慌；un-否定，意为不易惊慌

example_en: The court ordered the forfeiture of his illegal gains.
example_zh: 法院下令没收他的非法所得。
note: 源自古法语forfait(犯罪)，指因违法而被没收的财产

example_en: Her grit saw her through the toughest training.
example_zh: 她的毅力帮助她度过了最艰苦的训练。

example_en: His sedulity earned him the respect of his professors.
example_zh: 他的勤勉赢得了教授们的尊重。
note: 拉丁语sedulus(坐着的，专注的)，指专心致志、勤勉不懈

example_en: The welter of voices made it hard to concentrate.
example_zh: 嘈杂的人声让人难以集中注意力。

example_en: The island remains unspoiled by tourism.
example_zh: 该岛屿尚未受到旅游业的破坏。
note: spoiled为spoil(毁坏)的过去分词，un-否定，意为未被破坏

example_en: His speech was resonant with the audience’s hopes.
example_zh: 他的演讲与观众的期望产生了强烈共鸣。
root: res-(再) + son(声音) + -ant(形容词后缀)
note: 再次发声，指声音回荡或引发强烈情感共鸣

example_en: The company donated funds as a gesture of goodwill.
example_zh: 公司捐款作为善意的表示。
note: 良好的意图或友善的态度，常用于商业或人际关系中

example_en: The situation is extricable with careful planning.
example_zh: 只要周密计划，这种情况是可以摆脱的。
note: 拉丁语extricare(摆脱)，ex-出 + tric(拉)，意为能够被拉出来

example_en: She had a transcendental experience during meditation.
example_zh: 她在冥想中有一次超越性的体验。
root: trans-(超越) + ascend(上升) + -ental(形容词后缀)
note: 超越普通经验或物质世界，常用于哲学或宗教语境

example_en: He’s so tightfisted he won’t even buy coffee for friends.

example_zh: 船只装载压舱物以在恶劣海面上保持稳定。

example_zh: 火熄后，炉膛里只剩下冷冷的炉渣。

example_zh: 即使被抓住作弊，他仍然不悔改。

example_en: The company announced a cessation of all operations due to financial difficulties.
example_zh: 公司宣布由于财务困难而停止所有业务。

example_zh: 他通过做社区服务来赎罪。

example_en: The company issued a caveat to its investors about the potential risks.
example_zh: 公司向其投资者发出警告，关于潜在风险。

example_en: The cypress tree is often associated with mourning and death.

example_zh: 利息会随时间积累。

example_en: The soldier was trained to snipe enemy targets.
example_zh: 士兵接受了狙击敌方目标的训练。

example_en: She coveted the expensive jewelry in the store window.
example_zh: 她觊觎着店窗里昂贵的珠宝。

example_en: The company's actions aggrieved the local community.
example_zh: 公司的行为冤枉了当地社区。

example_en: The politician's recantation of his previous statement was met with skepticism.
example_zh: 政客对他之前声明的撤回遭到了怀疑。

example_en: The company's retrenchment measures included layoffs and budget cuts.
example_zh: 公司的削减措施包括裁员和预算削减。

example_en: She had foreknowledge of the exam questions.
example_zh: 她预知了考试题目。

example_en: The veterinarian had to emasculate the aggressive dog.
example_zh: 兽医不得不阉割攻击性的狗。

example_en: The city was an inferno after the bombing.
example_zh: 轰炸后，城市变成了地狱。

example_en: The interstice between the rocks was narrow.
example_zh: 岩石之间的间隙很狭窄。

example_en: The company was mulcted for violating environmental regulations.
example_zh: 公司因违反环境法规被罚款。

example_en: The queasy feeling after eating the spoiled food was unbearable.
example_zh: 吃了变质的食物后感到恶心，难以忍受。

example_en: The university has a strong program in aeronautics.
example_zh: 该大学的航空工程专业很强。

example_en: The treacherous mountain path was difficult to climb.
example_zh: 险恶的山路难以攀登。

example_en: She felt assured of her ability to complete the project.
example_zh: 她对自己能够完成项目充满信心。

example_en: The politician's speech was full of fustian.
example_zh: 政客的演讲充满了夸张的话。

example_en: He prated on about his new car for hours.
example_zh: 他喋喋不休地谈了几个小时关于他的新车。

example_en: She was lost in reverie, thinking about her future.
example_zh: 她陷入了幻想，思考着自己的未来。

example_en: The dilapidated house had been abandoned for years.
example_zh: 这栋破旧的房子已经被废弃多年了。

example_en: She took a painkiller to relieve her headache.
example_zh: 她服用了一种止痛药来缓解头痛。

example_en: The tempestuous weather made it difficult to sail.
example_zh: 暴风雨的天气使得航行变得困难。

example_en: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise after only a month on the job.
example_zh: 他厚颜无耻地在工作仅一个月后就要求加薪。

example_en: She felt depressed after losing her job.
example_zh: 她在失业后感到抑郁。

example_en: The nautical museum showcased a variety of ships and boats.
example_zh: 航海博物馆展示了各种各样的船只和艇。

example_en: She decided to broach the subject of her salary with her boss.
example_zh: 她决定向老板提起她的工资问题。

example_en: The insurgents launched a surprise attack on the government forces.
example_zh: 起义者对政府军发动了突然袭击。

example_en: The supernova explosion was visible from Earth.
example_zh: 超新星爆炸从地球上可以看到。

example_en: The shoddy workmanship of the product was disappointing.
example_zh: 产品的劣质工艺令人失望。

example_en: The sweet music began to cloy after a while.
example_zh: 甜美的音乐过了一会儿开始使人感到厌烦。

example_en: The hedgehog curled up into a ball for defense.
example_zh: 刺猬为防御而蜷缩成一个球体。

example_en: She fell headlong down the stairs.
example_zh: 她头先着地地从楼梯上摔了下来。

example_en: He glowered at his opponent across the table.
example_zh: 他怒视着对面的对手。

example_en: The child's excitability made it hard for her to calm down.
example_zh: 孩子的兴奋性使得她很难平静下来。

example_en: She was a dutiful daughter, always taking care of her parents.
example_zh: 她是一个尽责的女儿，总是照顾她的父母。

example_en: The thrall was forced to work long hours in the fields.
example_zh: 奴隶被迫在田地里长时间工作。

example_en: The tapestry depicted a beautiful landscape.
example_zh: 挂毯描绘了一幅美丽的风景。

example_en: The food was scant, and many people went hungry.
example_zh: 食物不足，很多人挨饿了。

example_en: The exiguous amount of money was not enough to cover the expenses.
example_zh: 微小的金额不足以覆盖费用。

example_en: The vestment of the priest was simple but dignified.
example_zh: 牧师的衣服简单但庄严。

example_en: He ogled the beautiful woman across the room.
example_zh: 他盯着房间对面的美丽女人看。

example_en: The wind tousled her hair, making it look messy.
example_zh: 风把她的头发弄乱了，使它看起来很凌乱。

example_en: The comedian's persiflage of the politician was hilarious.
example_zh: 喜剧演员对政客的讽刺非常搞笑。

example_en: She hankers for a career change.
example_zh: 她渴望换工作。

example_en: The surgeon's dexterity with the scalpel was impressive.
example_zh: 外科医生的手术技巧令人印象深刻。

example_en: The comedian was heckled by a member of the audience.
example_zh: 喜剧演员被观众嘲笑。

example_en: The backhanded compliment made her feel uncomfortable.
example_zh: 那句不友好的赞美让她感到不舒服。

example_en: The sibilant sounds in the language are difficult to pronounce.
example_zh: 这种语言的嘶音很难发音。

example_en: The satiny fabric felt smooth to the touch.
example_zh: 丝绸般的面料摸起来很光滑。

example_en: The student was accused of plagiarism in his essay.
example_zh: 学生被指控在论文中抄袭。

example_en: The interrogative tone of the question made her feel defensive.
example_zh: 问题的疑问语气让她感到防御性。

example_en: The artist's studio was in the garret of the old building.
example_zh: 艺术家的工作室在老建筑的阁楼里。

example_en: The flamboyant decorations made the party unforgettable.
example_zh: 华丽的装饰让聚会难忘。

example_en: She studied pediatrics in medical school.
example_zh: 她在医学院学习儿科。

example_en: The pharisaic attitude of the politician was criticized.
example_zh: 政客的伪善态度受到批评。

example_en: The farmer raised swine on his farm.
example_zh: 农民在他的农场养猪。

example_en: The parliament was prorogued until next year.
example_zh: 议会休会到明年。

example_en: The brook ran through the center of the village.
example_zh: 小溪流经村庄中心。

example_en: The nurse disinfected the wound before dressing it.
example_zh: 护士在包扎伤口前消毒。

example_en: The kids played a caper on their teacher.
example_zh: 孩子们对老师玩了一个恶作剧。

example_en: The brat refused to listen to his parents.
example_zh: 顽童拒绝听父母的话。

example_en: The heat vitrified the sand into glass.
example_zh: 热量使沙子变成玻璃。

example_en: The dysfunctional family had many problems.
example_zh: 功能失常的家庭有很多问题。

example_en: The act of sacrilege was punished severely.
example_zh: 亵渎行为受到严厉惩罚。

example_en: The bride's family paid a large dowry to the groom's family.
example_zh: 新娘的家人向新郎的家人支付了大量的嫁妆。

example_en: The jeans were made of durable denim.
example_zh: 牛仔裤由耐用的牛仔布制成。

example_en: The aspen trees swayed gently in the breeze.
example_zh: 白杨树在微风中轻轻摇晃。

example_en: The ancient Egyptians deified their pharaohs.
example_zh: 古埃及人将他们的法老神化了。
root: de-(使成为) + i-(神) + fy(使成为)

example_en: The company will divest its subsidiary.
example_zh: 公司将脱离其子公司。

example_en: The scandal maculated the politician's reputation.
example_zh: 丑闻玷污了政治家的名誉。

example_en: The bassoon is a large woodwind instrument.
example_zh: 巴松管是一种大型的木管乐器。

example_en: The fervid fans cheered for their team.
example_zh: 热情的球迷为他们的队伍加油。

example_en: The ornate decorations filled the room.
example_zh: 华丽的装饰充满了整个房间。

example_en: The company will indemnify the victims.
example_zh: 公司将赔偿受害者。
root: in-(向内) + demn-(损害) + ify(使成为)

example_en: The hospital will sterilize the equipment.
example_zh: 医院将灭菌设备。

example_en: Hypertension is a common health problem.
example_zh: 高血压是一个常见的健康问题。
root: hyper-(过高) + tens-(紧张) + ion(状态)
note: 通过词根联想为高血压

example_en: The shibboleth was used to identify the members.
example_zh: 口令被用来识别成员。

example_en: The new medicine is efficacious.
example_zh: 新药物是有效的。

example_en: The daft idea was rejected.
example_zh: 愚蠢的想法被拒绝了。

example_en: The alluring advertisement attracted many customers.
example_zh: 诱人的广告吸引了很多顾客。

example_en: The rope was tautened to secure the load.
example_zh: 绳子被拉紧以固定货物。

example_en: The priest exorcised the demon.
example_zh: 牧师驱逐了恶魔。
root: ex-(出去) + orci-(魔鬼) + se(使成为)

example_en: The minutia of the contract was carefully reviewed.
example_zh: 合同的细节被仔细审查。

example_en: The vesture of the ancient civilization was simple.
example_zh: 古代文明的衣服很简单。

example_en: Metallurgy is an important field of study.
example_zh: 冶金学是一个重要的研究领域。
note: 通过词根联想为冶金学

example_en: The obsequious employee tried to please his boss.
example_zh: 谄媚的员工试图取悦他的老板。

example_en: The meal sated my hunger.
example_zh: 这顿饭满足了我的饥饿。

example_en: The apocrypha was not included in the Bible.
example_zh: 伪经没有被包含在圣经中。
root: apo-(远离) + cryph-(隐藏) + a(状态)

example_en: The lobe of the ear is sensitive.
example_zh: 耳朵的叶状体很敏感。

example_en: The execration of the crowd was loud.
example_zh: 人群的咒骂声很大。
root: ex-(出去) + ecra-(咒骂) + tion(状态)

example_en: The court sequestrated the assets.
example_zh: 法院没收了资产。
root: se-(分离) + questr-(托管) + ate(使成为)

example_en: The child fidgeted in his seat.
example_zh: 孩子在座位上烦躁地动来动去。

example_en: The picture hung awry on the wall.
example_zh: 画歪斜地挂在墙上。

example_en: The patrician family has a long history.
example_zh: 这个贵族家庭有着悠久的历史。

example_en: The vestigial tail is a remnant of evolution.
example_zh: 残余的尾巴是进化的遗迹。

example_en: Spiders and scorpions are arachnids.
example_zh: 蜘蛛和蝎子都是蛛形类动物。

example_en: The patient experienced a hallucination.
example_zh: 患者出现了幻觉。

example_en: The provisional government will be in power for a year.
example_zh: 临时政府将执政一年。

example_en: The sculptor chiseled the marble statue.
example_zh: 雕塑家凿刻大理石雕像。

example_en: The irreducible complexity of the system makes it hard to understand.
example_zh: 系统的不可还原复杂性使其难以理解。

example_en: The child was diagnosed with hyperactivity.
example_zh: 孩子被诊断出患有多动症。

example_en: The new evidence exonerated the accused.
example_zh: 新证据洗清了被告的罪名。

example_en: The manager deputized the assistant to make the decision.
example_zh: 经理委任助理做出决定。

example_en: The apocryphal story has been passed down for generations.
example_zh: 这个虚构的故事已经传承了几代。

example_en: The water swirled around the drain.
example_zh: 水在排水口处旋转。

example_en: The students are on recess.
example_zh: 学生们正在休息。

example_en: The estranged couple has not spoken in years.
example_zh: 这对疏远的夫妇多年没有说话了。

example_en: The well-groomed dog won the competition.
example_zh: 这只修饰良好的狗赢得了比赛。

example_en: The votary spent her life in devotion to the deity.
example_zh: 虔诚者一生都在虔诚地侍奉神灵。

example_en: The speaker began to divagate from the main topic.
example_zh: 演讲者开始离题了。

example_en: The delinquent teenager was sent to juvenile court.
example_zh: 这个不法的青少年被送到少年法庭。

example_en: The stoic philosopher endured the pain with calmness.
example_zh: 坚忍的哲学家以平静的心态忍受了痛苦。

example_en: The artist mixed colors on her palette.
example_zh: 艺术家在她的调色板上混合颜色。

example_en: The pacifist refused to fight in the war.
example_zh: 和平主义者拒绝参加战争。

example_en: The vaunting athlete boasted about his victory.
example_zh: 自夸的运动员夸耀他的胜利。

example_en: The epistolary novel consists of a series of letters.
example_zh: 书信体小说由一系列信件组成。

example_en: She crocheted a beautiful scarf.
example_zh: 她用钩针织了一条漂亮的围巾。

example_en: The cavalry charged across the plain to break the enemy line.
example_zh: 骑兵冲过平原以突破敌方防线。
note: 源自拉丁语 caballus（马），指骑马作战的兵种。

example_en: After the heavy meal, he felt lethargic and couldn't concentrate.
example_zh: 吃饱饭后，他感到昏昏欲睡，无法集中注意力。
note: 来自希腊语 lēthargos（遗忘的），暗示精神萎靡。

example_en: Only an imbecile would believe such an obvious lie.
example_zh: 只有白痴才会相信如此明显的谎言。
note: 拉丁语 imbecillus 原指身体虚弱，后引申为智力低下。

example_en: Rumors of layoffs were rife throughout the office.
example_zh: 办公室里到处传布裁员的谣言。
root: 古英语 rȳfe（丰富的），无明显词根拆解

example_en: Her positiveness inspired the team to keep going despite setbacks.
example_zh: 她的积极性激励团队在挫折中坚持前进。
note: 由形容词 positive 构成名词，表示积极态度或性质。

example_en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the boss by bringing coffee every morning.
example_zh: 他每天早上给老板送咖啡，试图讨好老板。
root: in-(向内) + gratus(愉快的) + -iate(动词后缀)
note: 字面意为“使自己令人愉快”，即讨好他人以获好感。

example_en: True leadership requires humility, not arrogance.
example_zh: 真正的领导力需要谦逊，而非傲慢。
note: 拉丁语 humus 意为“土”，谦逊者如土般低沉，不自傲。

example_en: His anger was warranted after being lied to repeatedly.
example_zh: 反复被欺骗后，他的愤怒是有理由的。
note: 源自古法语 warant（担保），意为“有根据地保证”。

example_en: Archaeologists uncovered paleolithic tools dating back 30,000 years.
example_zh: 考古学家发现了可追溯到3万年前的旧石器时代工具。
note: 希腊语 palaios（古老的）+ lithos（石头），指旧石器时代。

example_en: The shark's dorsal fin cut through the water like a knife.
example_zh: 鲨鱼的背鳍像刀一样划过水面。
note: 拉丁语 dorsum 意为“背”，常用于描述动物背部结构。

example_en: Bears are opportunistic foragers, eating anything from berries to fish.
example_zh: 熊是机会主义的觅食者，吃从浆果到鱼的一切东西。
note: 来自古法语 fourrage（饲料），指寻找食物的动物或人。

example_en: The chef served marbled beef that melted in the mouth.
example_zh: 厨师上了花纹牛肉，入口即化。
note: 形容纹理如大理石般花纹分明，常用于肉类或石材。

example_en: The old mariner had sailed every ocean and knew the stars by heart.
example_zh: 这位老水手曾环游所有海洋，星星对他而言如同掌纹。
note: 拉丁语 marinus（海的），指从事海上航行的人。

example_en: The leather cover was embossed with the university's seal.
example_zh: 皮革封面被压印了大学的校徽。
note: 古法语 embosser（使凸起），指在表面压出凸起图案。

example_en: She is the protagonist of the novel, driving the plot forward with her choices.
example_zh: 她是小说的主角，凭借自己的选择推动情节发展。
note: 希腊语 protagonistes 意为“第一个竞争者”，即剧中的主角。

example_en: The deluge after the dam broke flooded the entire valley.
example_zh: 水库大坝决堤后的洪水淹没了整个山谷。
note: 拉丁语 diluvium 意为“洪水”，强调巨大的冲刷力。

example_en: He began to perspire heavily during the intense workout.
example_zh: 他在剧烈锻炼中开始大量出汗。
note: 拉丁语 perspirare 原指“透过皮肤呼吸”，后特指排汗。

example_en: The club will debar anyone under 18 from entering after 10 PM.
example_zh: 俱乐部将禁止18岁以下的人在晚上10点后进入。
note: 字面意为“移除栏杆之外”，即把人挡在门外。

example_en: Please save the report in the 'Finance Q3' folder on the shared drive.
example_zh: 请将报告保存在共享驱动器的‘财务Q3’文件夹中。
note: 源自折叠纸张存放文件的习惯，现指电子或实体文件容器。

example_en: The interregnum between the king's death and his successor's coronation lasted two years.
example_zh: 国王去世与继任者加冕之间的空位期持续了两年。
note: 拉丁语 interregnum 意为“王权之间的时期”，指权力真空期。

example_en: Working in politics disillusioned her idealistic views of government.
example_zh: 从政经历让她对政府的理想主义幻想彻底破灭。
note: 去除幻想，使人认识到现实的残酷真相。

example_en: After weeks of strict dieting, she finally unbent and ate a slice of cake.
example_zh: 严格节食几周后，她终于放松了一下，吃了一块蛋糕。
note: 字面意为“不再弯腰驼背”，比喻放下严肃态度，恢复自然。

example_en: The insidious spread of misinformation eroded public trust in science.
example_zh: 错误信息的阴险传播削弱了公众对科学的信任。
note: 拉丁语 insidiae 意为“伏击”，暗示危险潜伏且不易察觉。

example_en: His inflammatory speech inflamed tensions between the two communities.
example_zh: 他的煽动性演讲加剧了两个社区之间的紧张关系。
note: 拉 inflammare 意为“点燃”，比喻激怒或加剧冲突。

example_en: After losing his faith, he fell into nihilism, believing life had no meaning.
example_zh: 失去信仰后，他陷入虚无主义，认为生命毫无意义。
note: 拉丁语 nihil 意为“无”，虚无主义否定一切价值和意义。

example_en: The overpowering smell of the flowers made me dizzy.
example_zh: 花的压倒性的香气让我头晕目眩。
note: 通过词根联想超出一般力量

example_en: The actors were waiting offstage for their cues.
example_zh: 演员们在舞台外等待着他们的提示。
note: 通过词根联想离开舞台

example_en: The miasma in the swamp made it difficult to breathe.
example_zh: 沼泽中的瘴气使得呼吸变得困难。
note: 通过词根联想污秽物质

example_en: The rumors about the company were unfounded and misleading.
example_zh: 关于公司的传闻毫无根据且具有误导性。
note: 通过词根联想没有基础

example_en: The blacksmith hammered the hot metal on the anvil.
example_zh: 铁匠在铁砧上锤打着热金属。

example_en: The company tried to aggrandize its influence in the market.
example_zh: 公司试图扩大其在市场中的影响力。
note: 通过词根联想增加大小

example_en: The crotchety old man always complained about the noise.
example_zh: 脾气古怪的老人总是抱怨着噪音。

example_en: She doffed her hat and coat when she entered the house.
example_zh: 她进入房子后脱掉了帽子和外套。
note: 通过词根联想去掉离开

example_en: The insoluble substance could not be dissolved in water.
example_zh: 不可溶的物质不能在水中溶解。
note: 通过词根联想不可溶解性

example_en: The homogeneity of the mixture was crucial for the experiment.
example_zh: 混合物的均匀性对于实验至关重要。
note: 通过词根联想同一产生状态

example_en: The disjunction between the two ideas was clear.
example_zh: 两个想法之间的分离很明显。
note: 通过词根联想分离连接

example_en: The providential event changed the course of history.
example_zh: 天意事件改变了历史的进程。
note: 通过词根联想提供性质

example_en: She finagled a ticket to the sold-out concert.
example_zh: 她巧妙地获得了一张售罄的演唱会门票。

example_en: The team's arsenal of skills helped them win the game.
example_zh: 球队的技能库帮助他们赢得了比赛。
note: 通过词根联想军械场所

example_en: After a month of exercise, he looked hale and hearty.
example_zh: 经过一个月的锻炼后，他看起来健康且充满活力。

example_en: The news stupefied the entire community.
example_zh: 新闻使整个社区惊呆了。

example_en: The archer shot an arrow at the target.
example_zh: 弓箭手向目标射了一箭。

example_en: The layover in Tokyo was a great opportunity to explore the city.
example_zh: 在东京的中转是一个探索城市的绝佳机会。
note: 通过词根联想放置在上面

example_en: Pecans are a popular ingredient in baking.
example_zh: 山核桃是烘焙中很受欢迎的配料。

example_en: The ursine creature roamed the forest.
example_zh: 熊一样的生物在森林中漫游。

example_en: The crew had to jettison the cargo to save the ship.
example_zh: 船员不得不丢弃货物来救船。
note: 通过词根联想抛弃物品

example_en: The bacterium was studied under the microscope.
example_zh: 细菌在显微镜下被研究。
note: 通过词根联想细菌物质

example_en: The abrasive surface was rough to the touch.
example_zh: 磨损的表面摸起来很粗糙。
note: 通过词根联想去掉擦性质

example_en: The barrister argued the case in court.
example_zh: 律师在法庭上辩论案件。

example_en: The professor's explanation was lucid and easy to understand.
example_zh: 教授的解释清晰易懂。
note: 通过词根联想光明性质

example_en: The landlocked country had to rely on its neighbors for access to the sea.
example_zh: 这个内陆国家不得不依靠邻国才能进入海洋。

example_en: Frogs are a type of amphibian that live in both water and on land.
example_zh: 青蛙是一种两栖动物，既可以生活在水中也可以生活在陆地上。

example_en: The scammer tried to dupe the old lady out of her savings.
example_zh: 骗子试图欺骗老太太拿走她的积蓄。

example_en: She was caught eavesdropping on her neighbor's conversation.
example_zh: 她被抓到偷听邻居的谈话。

example_en: The fishermen trawled the ocean floor for hours.
example_zh: 渔民们花了几个小时拖网捕鱼。

example_en: The company requires an upfront payment before starting the project.
example_zh: 公司要求在开始项目前预付费用。

example_en: The knife nicked my finger.
example_zh: 刀子轻微划伤了我的手指。

example_en: The exchequer is responsible for managing the country's finances.
example_zh: 国库负责管理国家的财政。

example_en: We're going on a jaunt to the beach this weekend.
example_zh: 我们这个周末要去海滩短途旅行。

example_en: The company's proprietary technology is a trade secret.
example_zh: 公司的专有技术是商业秘密。

example_en: The responsiveness of the new smartphone is impressive.
example_zh: 新智能手机的响应性令人印象深刻。

example_en: She is a vivacious person who always makes people laugh.
example_zh: 她是一个充满活力的女人，总能让人发笑。

example_en: The centurion was a high-ranking officer in the Roman army.
example_zh: 百夫长是罗马军队中的高级军官。

example_en: The government will excise a tax on luxury goods.
example_zh: 政府将对奢侈品征税。

example_en: The encomiastic speech praised the achievements of the team.
example_zh: 赞美的演讲赞扬了团队的成就。

example_en: Leonardo da Vinci was a polymath who excelled in many fields.
example_zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一个博学家，擅长多个领域。

example_en: The quotidian routine of waking up early was tiring.
example_zh: 每天早起的日常生活很累。

example_en: He is the doyen of the literary world.
example_zh: 他是文学界的权威人士。

example_en: The baron was a wealthy and influential nobleman.
example_zh: 男爵是一个富有且有影响力的贵族。

example_en: The comedian's puns made the audience laugh.
example_zh: 喜剧演员的双关语让观众发笑。

example_en: The storm thrashed the coast with strong winds and heavy rain.
example_zh: 风暴用强风和大雨猛烈打击了海岸。

example_en: The general outmaneuvered the enemy and won the battle.
example_zh: 将军智胜了敌人并赢得了战斗。

example_en: The farmer used a hoe to weed the garden.
example_zh: 农民用锄头除去花园里的杂草。

example_en: The patient was diagnosed with gastritis and prescribed medication.
example_zh: 患者被诊断出患有胃炎并被开处方药。

example_en: The demotic language is the language of the common people.
example_zh: 民众语言是普通百姓的语言。

example_en: The athlete's unspotted record was a testament to her dedication.
example_zh: 运动员的无瑕记录是她奉献精神的见证。

example_en: She felt squeamish after watching the horror movie.
example_zh: 看完恐怖电影后，她感到恶心。

example_en: The professor's unimpassioned tone made the lecture seem dull.
example_zh: 教授不感性的语调使讲座显得枯燥。

example_en: The geologist studied the stratified rocks to understand the earth's history.
example_zh: 地质学家研究分层岩石以了解地球的历史。

example_en: The company used a pantechnicon to transport their equipment.
example_zh: 公司用大型货车运输他们的设备。
note: 通过全部和技艺的概念理解

example_en: The impecunious artist had to rely on donations to fund his projects.
example_zh: 贫穷的艺术家不得不依靠捐款来资助他的项目。

example_en: Beets are a popular ingredient in salads.
example_zh: 甜菜是沙拉中流行的食材。

example_en: The company encapsulated the new technology in a user-friendly device.
example_zh: 公司将新技术封装在一个用户友好的设备中。
note: 通过在内和小盒的概念理解

example_en: The dentist examined the patient's incisors for any signs of decay.
example_zh: 牙医检查患者的切牙是否有任何腐烂的迹象。
note: 通过在和切割的概念理解

example_en: The blood will coagulate if it is exposed to air.
example_zh: 如果血液暴露在空气中，它会凝固。
note: 通过一起和凝集的概念理解

example_en: The unidimensional approach to the problem was too simplistic.
example_zh: 对问题的单一维度方法太过简单。
note: 通过单一和维度的概念理解

example_en: The condor is a majestic bird of prey.
example_zh: 秃鹰是一种雄伟的掠食鸟。

example_en: She used a colander to drain the pasta.
example_zh: 她用滤器来排干意大利面。
note: 通过筛和器的概念理解

example_en: He made a comment apropos of the current situation.
example_zh: 他对当前情况做了适时的评论。
note: 通过至和目的的概念理解

example_en: The couple took a romantic promenade along the beach.
example_zh: 这对情侣沿着海滩进行了一次浪漫的散步。
note: 通过前和走的概念理解

example_en: The new policy has a semblance of fairness, but it is actually biased.
example_zh: 新政策看起来公平，但实际上是有偏见的。
note: 通过像和平衡的概念理解

example_en: The damped oscillations eventually came to a stop.
example_zh: 抑制的振动最终停止了。
note: 通过湿和被的概念理解

example_en: The ornithologist spent years studying the behavior of birds.
example_zh: 鸟类学家花了多年时间研究鸟类的行为。
note: 通过鸟和学者的概念理解

example_en: The news of the scandal caused a great eclat in the media.
example_zh: 丑闻的消息在媒体上引起了巨大的轰动。
note: 通过出和响亮的概念理解

example_en: The company's marketing campaign was a juggernaut that crushed the competition.
example_zh: 公司的营销活动是一种压倒性力量，击败了竞争对手。
note: 通过压倒和力量的概念理解

example_en: The mulish child refused to listen to his parents.
example_zh: 倔强的孩子拒绝听父母的话。
note: 通过骡和像的概念理解

example_en: The capillary action of the plant allowed it to absorb water from the soil.
example_zh: 植物的毛细作用使其能够从土壤中吸收水分。
note: 通过头发和相关的概念理解

example_en: She wore a pair of sandals to the beach.
example_zh: 她穿了一双凉鞋去海滩。

example_en: The hypotenuse of a right triangle is the longest side.
example_zh: 直角三角形的斜边是最长的一边。
note: 通过下、拉和使用的概念理解

example_en: The granules of sugar were too fine to be used in the recipe.
example_zh: 糖的颗粒太细，无法用于配方。
note: 通过颗粒和小的概念理解

example_en: She wore a flannel shirt to keep warm.
example_zh: 她穿着法兰绒衬衫来保持温暖。

example_en: The swarthy complexion of the man made him look exotic.
example_zh: 那个男人的黝黑皮肤使他看起来很异国情调。

example_en: The fresh air invigorated her after a long illness.
example_zh: 新鲜的空气让她在长期疾病后感到精力充沛。

example_en: The vile smell from the dumpster was unbearable.
example_zh: 垃圾箱发出的恶臭难以忍受。

example_en: The farmer raised a flock of ewes on his farm.
example_zh: 农民在他的农场上养了一群母羊。

example_en: After years of traveling, she felt jaded and needed a break.
example_zh: 多年旅行后，她感到厌倦，需要休息一下。

example_en: He had a quixotic idea to travel around the world on a bicycle.
example_zh: 他有一个奇想的想法，想骑自行车环游世界。

example_en: Her affectation of a British accent was annoying.
example_zh: 她装腔作势地使用英国口音很令人讨厌。

example_en: The city's water supply came from a large aquifer.
example_zh: 城市的水源来自一个大型含水层。

example_en: In ancient myths, the sibyl was said to have prophetic powers.
example_zh: 在古代神话中，女巫据说拥有预言能力。

example_en: The ancient navigators used an astrolabe to determine their position.
example_zh: 古代航海家使用星盘来确定他们的位置。

example_en: The toady always tried to flatter his boss to get ahead.
example_zh: 谄媚者总是试图讨好他的老板以获得晋升。

example_en: The poignant story of the orphan touched everyone's heart.
example_zh: 孤儿的感人故事感动了每个人的心。

example_en: The machine extruded the plastic into a long tube.
example_zh: 机器将塑料挤成长管。

example_en: The court's decision was a vindication of her innocence.
example_zh: 法院的判决是对她清白的辩护。

example_en: The rampant growth of weeds in the garden was a problem.
example_zh: 花园中杂草的猖獗生长是一个问题。

example_en: The doctor tried to palliate the patient's pain with medication.
example_zh: 医生试图用药物缓和患者的疼痛。

example_en: She jabbered on about her day, barely letting me get a word in.
example_zh: 她唠叨着她的这一天，几乎不让我插话。

example_en: He was livid when he found out he had been cheated.
example_zh: 他发现自己被骗时怒气冲天。

example_en: The young acolyte assisted the priest during the ceremony.
example_zh: 年轻的侍从在仪式期间协助神父。

example_en: The progenitor of the family was a brave warrior.
example_zh: 这个家庭的祖先是一位勇敢的战士。

example_en: The blooming flowers in the garden were beautiful.
example_zh: 花园中盛开的花朵很美丽。

example_en: We had to retrace our steps to find the lost path.
example_zh: 我们不得不重走我们的步伐来找到丢失的路径。

example_en: The professor tried to particularize the abstract concept for the students.
example_zh: 教授试图为学生具体化抽象的概念。

example_en: The cowboy began to lope across the open plain.
example_zh: 牛仔开始大步走过开阔的平原。

example_en: The doctor said I had a stomach ulcer.
example_zh: 医生说我有胃溃疡。

example_en: Her judiciousness in handling the crisis was impressive.
example_zh: 她处理危机的明智态度令人佩服。

example_en: The vaporous air made it hard to breathe.
example_zh: 有蒸气的空气使得呼吸困难。

example_en: The derelict building stood as a reminder of the past.
example_zh: 废弃的建筑物是过去的见证。

example_en: The two companies will meld their operations.
example_zh: 两家公司将融合他们的业务。

example_en: The professor belabored the point to make sure we understood.
example_zh: 教授详细说明这个观点以确保我们理解。

example_en: The percussionist's performance was energetic.
example_zh: 打击乐手的表演很有活力。

example_en: His stinginess made him unpopular.
example_zh: 他的吝啬使他不受欢迎。

example_en: She hummed a happy ditty as she worked.
example_zh: 她工作时哼着一首快乐的小曲子。

example_en: He gloated over his opponent's defeat.
example_zh: 他对对手的失败幸灾乐祸。

example_en: I procrastinated and didn't finish my homework.
example_zh: 我拖延了没有完成我的作业。

example_en: The filly ran quickly across the field.
example_zh: 小母马快速地跑过田野。

example_en: The truss supported the roof.
example_zh: 桁架支撑着屋顶。

example_en: The sane decision was to leave the party early.
example_zh: 理智的决定是早点离开聚会。

example_en: The cartographer drew a detailed map.
example_zh: 制图师绘制了一张详细的地图。

example_en: The carpenter swept up the shavings.
example_zh: 木匠扫起了刨花。

example_en: The heat will liquefy the ice.
example_zh: 热量会使冰液化。

example_en: She accepted the challenge with alacrity.
example_zh: 她热情地接受了挑战。

example_en: The child teetered on the edge of the chair.
example_zh: 孩子在椅子边缘摇晃。

example_en: The disease is endemic in this region.
example_zh: 这种疾病在这个地区是地方性的。

example_en: The sculpture focused on the torso.
example_zh: 雕塑注重躯干。

example_en: The company tried to falsify the financial reports.
example_zh: 公司试图伪造财务报告。

example_en: The forensic team analyzed the evidence.
example_zh: 法医学团队分析了证据。

example_en: The king traveled with a large retinue.
example_zh: 国王带着一大群随从旅行。

example_en: The boxer pummeled his opponent with punches.
example_zh: 拳击手用拳头猛烈打击对手。

example_en: Her unfailing optimism inspired us all.
example_zh: 她坚定不移的乐观情绪激励着我们所有人。

example_en: The witches formed a coven to practice their craft.
example_zh: 女巫们成立了一个集会来练习她们的魔法。

example_en: The fascia surrounds and supports the muscles.
example_zh: 筋膜包围并支持肌肉。

example_en: The restive horse was difficult to ride.
example_zh: 不安的马很难骑。

example_en: We used a tarpaulin to cover the boat.
example_zh: 我们用防水布来覆盖船。

example_en: The sheriff is responsible for maintaining law and order.
example_zh: 警长负责维持法律和秩序。

example_en: The surveyor mapped out the boundaries of the property.
example_zh: 测量员绘制了房产的边界。

example_en: Mash the potatoes with a fork.
example_zh: 用叉子压碎土豆。

example_en: She wore her hair in ringlets.
example_zh: 她把头发做成卷发。

example_en: The equine virus affects horses and donkeys.
example_zh: 马病毒影响马和驴。

example_en: The clouds scudded across the sky.
example_zh: 云朵疾驰过天空。

example_en: We spent the evening in palaver and laughter.
example_zh: 我们整个晚上都在闲聊和笑声中度过。

example_en: A gaggle of geese waddled across the lawn.
example_zh: 一群鹅蹒跚地走过草坪。

example_en: The newspaper was sued for traducing the politician's character.
example_zh: 报纸因诽谤政治家的性格而被起诉。

example_en: The war impoverished the entire nation.
example_zh: 战争使整个国家贫穷化。

example_en: The king's magnanimity towards his enemies was admirable.
example_zh: 国王对敌人的宽容令人钦佩。

example_en: The old man doddered along the street.
example_zh: 老人蹒跚地走过街头。

example_en: He drawled out the words in a slow, southern accent.
example_zh: 他拖长声音以缓慢的南方口音说出这些词。

example_en: The bleachers were filled with cheering fans.
example_zh: 看台上挤满了欢呼的球迷。

example_en: The bloated corpse was found in the river.
example_zh: 肿胀的尸体被发现漂浮在河中。

example_en: The fulsome praise made her feel uncomfortable.
example_zh: 过分的赞扬使她感到不舒服。

example_en: The personification of justice is often depicted as a blindfolded woman.
example_zh: 正义的拟人化通常被描绘成一个蒙着眼睛的女人。

example_en: The bedraggled traveler stumbled into the hotel.
example_zh: 凌乱的旅行者跌跌撞撞地进入了酒店。

example_en: The intangibility of love makes it hard to define.
example_zh: 爱的无形性使其难以定义。

example_en: The politician's locution was carefully chosen to avoid controversy.
example_zh: 政治家的措辞被仔细选择以避免争议。

example_en: That dance was just a fad and faded quickly.
example_zh: 那个舞蹈只是一时的潮流，很快就过时了。

example_en: She wore a colorful poncho to stay dry in the rain.
example_zh: 她穿着彩色斗篷以保持雨天干燥。

example_en: The report provides a conspectus of global climate trends.
example_zh: 该报告提供了全球气候趋势的概述。

example_en: The contractor underbid the project to win the contract.
example_zh: 承包商故意低价竞标以赢得该项目。

example_en: He stepped gingerly over the broken glass.
example_zh: 他小心翼翼地跨过碎玻璃。

example_en: The malefactor was arrested for fraud and embezzlement.
example_zh: 该作恶者因欺诈和挪用公款被捕。

example_en: Her bewitching smile captivated everyone in the room.
example_zh: 她迷人的笑容吸引了屋内所有人的目光。
note: 如被巫术迷住般吸引人

example_en: The artist set up her easel by the window to paint the landscape.
example_zh: 画家在窗边架起画架来画风景。

example_en: The maleficent influence of propaganda distorted public opinion.
example_zh: 宣传的有害影响扭曲了公众舆论。

example_en: The film’s opening montage showed decades of history in seconds.
example_zh: 电影开头的蒙太奇用几秒钟展示了数十年的历史。

example_en: He signed an indenture to work for seven years in exchange for passage to America.
example_zh: 他签订了一份契约，以换取前往美国的船票，同意工作七年。
note: 齿状契约文件（历史指双边缘有齿状防伪）

example_en: She gave a lachrymose farewell as she boarded the train.
example_zh: 她泪流满面地告别，登上了火车。

example_en: The prophet denounced the iniquity of the ruling class.
example_zh: 先知谴责统治阶级的不义行为。

example_en: As a valetudinarian, he avoids cold weather and strenuous exercise.
example_zh: 作为一个多病者，他避免寒冷天气和剧烈运动。
note: 关注健康的人，尤指体弱多病者

example_en: It was a small victory, albeit an important one.
example_zh: 这是一个小胜利，虽然重要。
root: all be it (虽然一切如此)

example_en: They looked back on their halcyon days of childhood with nostalgia.
example_zh: 他们怀念那些宁静美好的童年时光。

example_en: He was calumniated by rivals who spread false rumors about his character.
example_zh: 他被竞争对手诽谤，他们散布关于他人品的假谣言。
note: 故意散布恶意谣言损害他人名誉

example_en: The lecture was so insipid that half the audience fell asleep.
example_zh: 这堂讲座乏味得让一半观众睡着了。
root: in-(不) + sapid(有味道的，来自 sapere)
note: 无味的，缺乏兴趣或刺激

example_en: The vendetta between the two families lasted for generations.
example_zh: 两家族之间的血仇持续了好几代。

example_en: The rumor was bruited about the office before any official announcement.
example_zh: 在任何官方声明之前，谣言就在办公室里被传播。

example_en: She bought a cheap bauble as a souvenir from the market.
example_zh: 她在市场上买了一个廉价的小饰品作为纪念。

example_en: The landslide gouged a deep scar into the hillside.
example_zh: 山体滑坡在山坡上凿出了一道深深的伤痕。

example_en: She scoured the pot until every trace of grease was gone.
example_zh: 她反复刷洗锅子，直到所有油渍都被清除。

example_en: Littoral zones are rich in biodiversity due to nutrient mixing.
example_zh: 海岸带由于养分混合而生物多样性丰富。
note: relating to the shore or coastal region

example_en: She spent her mornings in devotional reading and prayer.
example_zh: 她每天早晨都进行虔诚的阅读和祈祷。
note: 表达敬拜或虔诚奉献的

example_en: He was a jovial man with a great sense of humor.
example_zh: 他是一个欢乐的男人，幽默感很强。

example_en: She was known for her capricious behavior.
example_zh: 她以反复无常的行为而闻名。

example_en: The rough handling coarsened the fabric.
example_zh: 粗暴的处理使得织物变得粗糙。

example_en: She felt apprehensive about the upcoming exam.
example_zh: 她对即将到来的考试感到担心。

example_en: The car careened off the road.
example_zh: 汽车倾斜地驶离了道路。

example_en: The child began to scribble on the wall.
example_zh: 孩子开始在墙上乱写。

example_en: The reaper cut the wheat with ease.
example_zh: 收割者轻松地割下了小麦。

example_en: The choreography of the ballet was intricate.
example_zh: 芭蕾舞的舞蹈编排很复杂。

example_en: The company consigned the goods to the shipping company.
example_zh: 公司将货物托运给了航运公司。

example_en: The aquiline nose was a distinctive feature.
example_zh: 像鹰的鼻子是一个显著的特征。

example_en: The news galvanized the community into action.
example_zh: 新闻使社区兴奋起来采取行动。

example_en: The couple decided to cohabit before marriage.
example_zh: 这对夫妇决定结婚前同居。

example_en: The larder was filled with all sorts of delicacies.
example_zh: 食品储藏室里充满了各种美食。

example_en: The threads interwove to form a complex pattern.
example_zh: 线条交织在一起形成了一个复杂的图案。

example_en: The company's financial debacle was widely reported.
example_zh: 公司的财务灾难被广泛报道。

example_en: She acquired a new skill through practice.
example_zh: 她通过练习获得了一项新技能。

example_en: The team felt euphoria after winning the championship.
example_zh: 球队在赢得冠军后感到欣快。

example_en: There was an upsurge in demand for the new product.
example_zh: 对新产品的需求激增。

example_en: The cowboy lassoed the wild horse.
example_zh: 牛仔套住了野马。

example_en: The proceeds from the sale will go to charity.
example_zh: 出售的收益将捐给慈善机构。

example_en: The stouthearted explorer ventured into the unknown.
example_zh: 大胆的探险家冒险进入了未知领域。

example_en: The dog began to slobber all over the floor.
example_zh: 狗开始在地板上流口水。

example_en: The invigorating music lifted our spirits.
example_zh: 令人振奋的音乐提振了我们的精神。

example_en: The cringing dog hid behind its owner.
example_zh: 畏缩的狗躲在主人后面。

example_en: A scad of papers covered the desk.
example_zh: 大量的文件覆盖了桌子。

example_en: The heliotrope flower follows the sun's movement.
example_zh: 向日葵花跟随太阳的运动。

example_en: Please redirect the link to the new website.
example_zh: 请将链接重定向到新网站。
note: 通过词根联想再次直接

example_en: The labile molecule is prone to decomposition.
example_zh: 不稳定的分子容易分解。
note: 通过词根联想滑动倾向

example_en: The fosse surrounded the ancient castle.
example_zh: 沟渠围绕着古城堡。

example_en: The draconian laws were enforced strictly.
example_zh: 严厉的法律被严格执行。
note: 通过词根联想龙的严厉

example_en: She reproved her son for his misbehavior.
example_zh: 她责备她的儿子因为他的不良行为。
note: 通过词根联想再次证明

example_en: The athlete's prowess earned her a gold medal.
example_zh: 运动员的才能为她赢得了一枚金牌。

example_en: The virago dominated the conversation.
example_zh: 泼妇占据了整个对话。

example_en: The nova exploded in the distant galaxy.
example_zh: 新星在遥远的星系中爆炸了。

example_en: He sought vengeance for his family's death.
example_zh: 他寻求对家人死亡的报复。

example_en: The patient suffered from jaundice.
example_zh: 患者患有黄疸。

example_en: The straitened circumstances forced them to economize.
example_zh: 窘迫的处境迫使他们节约。

example_en: The children scuttered across the playground.
example_zh: 孩子们疾走过操场。

example_en: The pliers were used to grip the small object.
example_zh: 钳子被用来夹住小物体。

example_en: The nemesis of the hero was a powerful villain.
example_zh: 英雄的对手是一个强大的恶棍。

example_en: The crockery was carefully packed to avoid breakage.
example_zh: 陶器被小心地包装以避免破碎。

example_en: She had a premonition that something was wrong.
example_zh: 她有种预感，觉得有些事情不对劲。

example_en: The kidneys excrete waste products from the blood.
example_zh: 肾脏从血液中排泄废物。

example_en: The population grew exponentially over the past decade.
example_zh: 人口在过去十年中指数级增长。

example_en: The elocution class helped her improve her public speaking skills.
example_zh: 演讲课帮助她提高了公共演讲技巧。

example_en: There was a hiatus in the conversation.
example_zh: 对话中出现了空隙。

example_en: Her demeanour was confident and assertive.
example_zh: 她的举止自信且果断。

example_en: The belated apology was not accepted.
example_zh: 迟到的道歉没有被接受。

example_en: The bricklayer worked on the construction site.
example_zh: 砖匠在建筑工地工作。

example_en: The two countries agreed to a truce.
example_zh: 两国同意休战。

example_en: The scandal revealed the complicity of several high-ranking officials.
example_zh: 丑闻揭露了几名高级官员的共谋。
note: 通过词根联想共谋的含义

example_en: The unregulated market led to a series of financial crises.
example_zh: 无管制的市场导致了一系列金融危机。
note: 通过词根理解无规则的状态

example_en: The murky water made it difficult to see anything underwater.
example_zh: 浑浊的水使得难以看到水下的东西。

example_en: She specializes in orthodontics and has helped many patients achieve perfect smiles.
example_zh: 她专攻矫正牙科，帮助许多患者获得完美的笑容。
note: 通过词根理解直牙的含义

example_en: The calibre of the gun was too large for the target.
example_zh: 枪的口径对目标来说太大了。

example_en: She managed to outfox her opponent in the debate.
example_zh: 她在辩论中智胜了对手。
note: 通过词根联想智胜的含义

example_en: The peery child kept asking questions about the world around her.
example_zh: 好奇的孩子不断问关于她周围世界的问题。

example_en: The storm finally began to relent, and the sun came out.
example_zh: 暴风终于开始减弱，太阳出来了。
note: 通过词根理解放松的含义

example_en: The hikers stumbled upon a beautiful glade in the middle of the forest.
example_zh: 徒步者在森林中间偶然发现了一个美丽的林间空地。

example_en: The emulsifier helped to emulsify the oil and water mixture.
example_zh: 乳化剂帮助乳化了油和水的混合物。
note: 通过词根理解模仿的含义

example_en: The denizens of the city were friendly and welcoming.
example_zh: 城市的居民友好且热情。
note: 通过词根联想居民的含义

example_en: The inequity of the system led to widespread protests.
example_zh: 制度的不公导致了广泛的抗议。
note: 通过词根理解不平等的含义

example_en: The team was sent to reconnoiter the enemy's position.
example_zh: 团队被派去侦察敌人的位置。
note: 通过词根理解再次知道的含义

example_en: The country was ruled by a theocracy, with the church holding significant power.
example_zh: 该国由神权政治统治，教会拥有显著的权力。
note: 通过词根理解神统治的含义

example_en: The alchemist spent years searching for the elixir of life.
example_zh: 炼金术士花了多年时间寻找长生不老药。

example_en: The duplicitous politician was caught in a scandal.
example_zh: 虚伪的政治家被卷入一场丑闻。
note: 通过词根理解复制的含义

example_en: The community was riven by disagreements and conflicts.
example_zh: 社区被分歧和冲突分裂了。

example_en: The judge's reputation was unimpeachable, and she was respected by all.
example_zh: 法官的声誉无可指责，她受到所有人的尊重。
note: 通过词根理解不指责的含义

example_en: The vertex of the triangle was the highest point.
example_zh: 三角形的顶点是最高点。
note: 通过词根理解转向外的含义

example_en: The braggadocio of the athlete was annoying to many fans.
example_zh: 运动员的吹嘘令许多球迷感到厌烦。

example_en: The team of speleologists explored the vast cave system.
example_zh: 洞穴学家团队探索了广阔的洞穴系统。
note: 通过词根理解洞穴学的含义

example_en: The child's constant questions began to pester the teacher.
example_zh: 孩子不断的提问开始烦扰老师。

example_en: The patient was isolated to prevent the spread of infection.
example_zh: 为了防止感染扩散，该患者被隔离。
note: in-向内 + sol独自 → 使独处，即隔离

example_en: The government decided to deport the illegal immigrant.
example_zh: 政府决定驱逐该非法移民出境。
note: de-离开 + port搬运 → 把人送走，即驱逐

example_en: NATO is a military alliance formed after World War II.
example_zh: 北约是二战后形成的军事同盟。
note: ad-向 + lig绑 → 被绑在一起，即结盟

example_en: Excessive drinking can impair liver function.
example_zh: 过量饮酒会损害肝脏功能。
note: in-否定 + par等同 → 不等同，即损害原有状态

example_en: The troops faced hostile fire from the enemy.
example_zh: 部队遭到来自敌方的敌对火力打击。
note: host敌人 + -ile → 具有敌人特性的，即敌对的

example_en: He wore a coarse wool sweater that scratched his skin.
example_zh: 他穿了一件粗糙的羊毛衫，刺得皮肤发痒。

example_en: The company announced plans for global expansion next year.
example_zh: 公司宣布了明年全球扩张的计划。
root: ex-(向外) + pand(展开) + -ion(名词后缀)
note: ex-向外 + pand展开 → 向外展开，即扩张

example_en: Her explanation brought clarity to a confusing situation.
example_zh: 她的解释使一个混乱的情况变得清晰明了。
note: clar清 + -ity → 清晰的状态，即清晰

example_en: Children are particularly vulnerable to malnutrition.
example_zh: 儿童尤其容易受到营养不良的影响。
note: vuln伤 + -able → 易受伤的，即脆弱的

example_en: The school was accused of segregating students by race.
example_zh: 该校被指控按种族隔离学生。
note: se-分开 + greg群 → 使群体分开，即隔离

example_en: The robot had a metallic voice that sounded cold and mechanical.
example_zh: 机器人有一种金属声，听起来冷冰冰的，很机械。
note: metal金属 + -ic → 具有金属性质的，即金属的

example_en: She envisaged a future where renewable energy powered every home.
example_zh: 她设想了一个未来：可再生能源为每户家庭供电。
note: en-使 + vis看 → 使之可见，即在脑中想象

example_en: Zinc is an essential mineral for immune function.
example_zh: 锌是维持免疫功能的必需矿物质。

example_en: The mystery slowly unfolded as more evidence came to light.
example_zh: 随着更多证据浮出水面，谜团逐渐展开。
note: un-逆 + fold折叠 → 逆折叠，即展开

example_en: He was arrested for trying to smuggle diamonds across the border.
example_zh: 他因试图将钻石走私过境而被捕。

example_en: The leaves floated down the stream after the rain.
example_zh: 雨后，树叶随溪流漂浮而下。

example_en: Her vote was the decisive factor in passing the bill.
example_zh: 她的一票是通过该法案的决定性因素。
note: de-强化 + cide切 → 一刀切断，即决定性的

example_en: She made a frantic search for her lost child in the crowd.
example_zh: 她在人群中狂乱地寻找走失的孩子。
note: fren狂 + -tic → 狂乱的状态，即狂乱的

example_en: The teacher's passion inspired students to pursue science.
example_zh: 老师的热情激发了学生们对科学的追求。
root: in-(向内) + spir(呼吸) + -e(动词后缀)
note: in-向内 + spir呼吸 → 吸入神气，即受鼓舞

example_en: She knits a scarf every winter for her grandfather.
example_zh: 她每个冬天都为祖父编织一条围巾。

example_en: Please dispose of the trash in the recycling bin.
example_zh: 请把垃圾放进回收箱进行处理。
note: dis-分开 + posit放置 → 把东西放开，即处理掉

example_en: He twisted the cap off the bottle with one hand.
example_zh: 他用一只手拧开了瓶盖。

example_en: They decorated the classroom with paper flowers for the festival.
example_zh: 他们用纸花装饰教室以庆祝节日。
note: de-强化 + orn装饰 → 使更加装饰，即装饰

example_en: Buying on impulse often leads to regret later.
example_zh: 冲动消费常常导致事后后悔。
root: in-(向内) + puls(推动) + -e(名词后缀)
note: in-向内 + puls推动 → 内部推动力，即冲动

example_en: The court proceedings were delayed due to lack of evidence.
example_zh: 因证据不足，法庭程序被推迟。
root: pro-(向前) + cess(走) + -ing(名词后缀) + -s(复数)
note: pro-向前 + cess走 → 向前进行的过程，即诉讼程序

example_en: The government introduced measures to curb inflation.
example_zh: 政府推出了一系列措施来抑制通货膨胀。

example_en: The hotel overlooks the sea.
example_zh: 这家酒店俯瞰着大海。

example_en: The museum displays ancient artifacts.
example_zh: 博物馆展出古代文物。
note: 把东西分开摆出来展示

example_en: He was bullied at school for being shy.
example_zh: 他因为内向而在学校被欺负。

example_en: The region was granted autonomy in 1999.
example_zh: 该地区在1999年获得了自治权。
note: 自己制定法则，意为自治

example_en: The police found a corpse in the river.
example_zh: 警方在河里发现了一具尸体。
note: 拉丁语 corpus 意为身体，corpse 为其派生词

example_en: Apply a second layer of paint after the first dries.
example_zh: 第一层油漆干后，再涂第二层。

example_en: They planted flowering shrubs along the garden path.
example_zh: 他们在花园小径两旁种植了开花灌木。

example_en: His joke embarrassed everyone in the room.
example_zh: 他的笑话让屋里所有人都感到尴尬。
note: 让人感到被阻碍，产生不自在感

example_en: Many regard him as a prophet of the digital age.
example_zh: 许多人认为他是数字时代的先知。

example_en: Please reserve a table for two at 7 p.m.
example_zh: 请为晚上7点预订一张两人桌。
note: 再次安排服务，意为预订

example_en: You need to adjust the settings before using the machine.
example_zh: 使用机器前，你需要先调整设置。
note: 使其变得恰当，意为调整

example_en: Her foremost concern is her children's education.
example_zh: 她首要的担忧是孩子的教育。
note: 最前面的，意为最重要的

example_en: Scientists successfully cloned a sheep in 1996.
example_zh: 科学家在1996年成功克隆了一只羊。
note: 源自希腊语 klon，意为嫩枝，引申为无性繁殖

example_en: Use a clamp to hold the wood steady while cutting.
example_zh: 锯木时用夹具将木头夹紧以保持稳定。

example_en: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
example_zh: 他们贷款买房，以房产作抵押。
note: 死契约，意为直到还清债务前房产归贷款方

example_en: The fridge door is held shut by a magnet.
example_zh: 冰箱门靠磁铁吸合而关闭。
note: 源自希腊语 magnētēs，意为磁石

example_en: She raised an objection to the proposed plan.
example_zh: 她对该提案提出了反对意见。
note: 把反对意见抛出来，意为提出反对

example_en: His persistent efforts finally paid off.
example_zh: 他的坚持努力终于有了回报。
note: 一直站着不动，意为坚持不懈

example_en: An electrical fault caused the power outage.
example_zh: 电气故障导致了停电。

example_en: There was a sudden surge in demand for face masks.
example_zh: 对口罩的需求突然激增。

example_en: The data points are discrete and not connected.
example_zh: 这些数据点是离散的，彼此之间没有连续性。

example_en: She hugged her friend tightly after not seeing her for years.
example_zh: 多年未见，她紧紧拥抱了她的朋友。

example_en: The volume of the box is 12 cubic centimeters.
example_zh: 这个盒子的体积是12立方厘米。
note: 卷起来的空间，意为体积

example_en: The engineer tested the prototype before mass production.
example_zh: 工程师在批量生产前测试了该产品的原型。

example_en: She tried to console him after the bad news.
example_zh: 她试图在他听到坏消息后安慰他。
note: con- 加强义，sol 来自拉丁语 solari 意为安慰

example_en: In retrospect, I realize I made a mistake.
example_zh: 回顾过去，我意识到自己犯了一个错误。
note: retro- 表示向后，spect 表示看，合起来是向后看＝回顾

example_en: He inherited a large property from his uncle.
example_zh: 他从叔叔那里继承了一大笔财产。
note: propri- 来自拉丁语 proprius 意为自己的，表示所有权

example_en: The forthcoming meeting will discuss budget cuts.
example_zh: 即将到来的会议将讨论预算削减。
note: forth- 表示向前，coming 表示来，合起来是即将到来的

example_en: Hitherto, we have seen no signs of improvement.
example_zh: 直至今，我们尚未看到任何改善的迹象。
note: hither 表示到这里，to 表示到，合起来是直至今

example_en: She was moved to the intensive care ward.
example_zh: 她被转移到了重症病房。

example_en: He is no more than a casual acquaintance.
example_zh: 他只不过是个普通的熟人。
note: ac- 表示向，quaint 来自拉语 cognitus 意为认识的，表示熟悉的人

example_en: The expedition to the Arctic took three months.
example_zh: 北极远征历时三个月。
note: ex- 表示出，ped 表示脚，合起来是出脚行走＝远征

example_en: We need to ascertain the cause of the accident.
example_zh: 我们需要查明事故的原因。
note: as- 加强义，certain 表示确定，合起来是确定下来＝查明

example_en: My colleague helped me finish the report.
example_zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
note: col- 表示共同，leg 来自拉语 lex 法律，原指同事共同遵守法律，后泛指同事

example_en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
example_zh: 太阳从云层后面露出来了。
note: e- 表示出来，merg 表示沉没，合起来是从沉没中出来＝出现

example_en: He tied the package with a string.
example_zh: 他用绳子把包裹绑起来。

example_en: She has a natural glamour that attracts everyone.
example_zh: 她天生具有吸引人的魅力。

example_en: The goods are in transit to the warehouse.
example_zh: 货物正在运往仓库的途中。
note: trans- 表示越过，it 表示去，合起来是越过去＝运输

example_en: The company was fined for breach of contract.
example_zh: 该公司因违反合同被罚款。

example_en: The children giggled at the clown's antics.
example_zh: 孩子们被小丑的动作逗得咯咯笑。

example_en: Don't lose your temper over small things.
example_zh: 别因为小事发脾气。
note: temp- 来自拉语 tempus 时间，原指气质随时间变化，后指脾气

example_en: This novel has become part of the literary canon.
example_zh: 这部小说已成为文学经典的一部分。

example_en: The detective found a crucial clue at the scene.
example_zh: 侦探在现场发现了一个关键线索。

example_en: You cannot disregard the safety rules.
example_zh: 你不能忽视安全规定。
note: dis- 表示否定，regard 表示考虑，合起来是不考虑＝忽视

example_en: Are you aware of the risks involved?
example_zh: 你意识到其中的风险吗？
note: a- 表示不，ware 来自古英语 wær 意为知道，合起来是不知道的反义＝知道的

example_en: She was destined to become a great scientist.
example_zh: 她注定要成为一位伟大的科学家。
note: de- 表示完全，stine 来自拉语 stare 站立，原指站在命运中，后指注定

example_en: The lawyer refuted the witness's testimony.
example_zh: 律师驳斥了证人的证词。
note: re- 表示反驳，fut 来自拉语 futi parlare 意为说话，合起来是反驳说话＝驳斥

example_en: Please cite your sources in the bibliography.
example_zh: 请在参考文献中引用你的来源。
note: ci- 来自拉语 citare 呼唤，原指呼唤作证，后指引用

example_en: He suffered a fracture in his left leg after the fall.
example_zh: 他摔倒后左腿骨折了。
note: frag- 来自拉语 frangere 破裂，表示骨头断裂＝骨折

example_en: She has lived in this city for a decade.
example_zh: 她在这座城市已经住了十年。
note: deca- 表示十，如 decagon 十边形

example_en: The choir sang in perfect harmony.
example_zh: 合唱团完美地和声演唱。
note: harmon 源自希腊语 harmonia，意为和调、一致

example_en: The bride lifted her veil as she walked down the aisle.
example_zh: 新娘走过通道时掀起了面纱。

example_en: The government needs to formulate a new education policy.
example_zh: 政府需要制定一项新的教育政策。
note: formulate 原指‘赋予形式’，引申为‘系统地制定’

example_en: His lack of experience is a real handicap in this job.
example_zh: 他缺乏经验在这份工作上是一个真正的障碍。
root: hand(手) + -icap(源自 ‘in cap’ 意为‘在帽中’)
note: 源自旧时赛马中将赌注放在帽子里，后来引申为不利条件

example_en: Harvard is one of the oldest institutions of higher learning in the US.
example_zh: 哈佛是美国最古老的高等学习机构之一。
root: in-(向内) + stat(站立) + -ution(名词后缀)
note: instat- 原指‘驻扎’，引申为‘建立固定机构’

example_en: Earth is the third planet from the sun.
example_zh: 地球是太阳系中距离太阳第三近的行星。
note: planet 源自希腊语 planētēs，意为‘漂流者’（古人认为行星在天空中漂移）

example_en: He was arrested for committing insurance fraud.
example_zh: 他因实施保险欺诈被逮捕。
note: 源自拉丁语 fraus，意为欺骗、损害

example_en: The joy of victory was transient; he soon felt empty again.
example_zh: 胜利的喜悦是短暂的；他很快又感到空虚。
root: trans-(越过) + ient(走) + -ent(形容词后缀)
note: transient 原指‘经过的’，引申为‘短暂的、瞬息的’

example_en: The soldiers checked their weapons before the patrol.
example_zh: 士兵们在巡逻前检查了他们的武器。
note: weap 源自古英语 wǣpn，意为武器，与 war 有关联

example_en: They visited the cemetery to honor their ancestors on Qingming Festival.
example_zh: 他们在清明节拜访墓地以纪念祖先。
note: cemetery 源自希腊语 koimeterion，意为‘睡眠之所’（委婉说死者在睡觉）

example_en: Artificial intelligence is rapidly expanding into new domains.
example_zh: 人工智能正迅速拓展到新的领域。
note: domain 原指‘领地、庄园’，引申为‘范围、领域’

example_en: The thief snatched her purse and ran away.
example_zh: 小偷抢走了她的手提包然后逃跑了。

example_en: Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren with too many sweets.
example_zh: 祖父母常常用太多甜点来宠坏他们的孙子孙女。

example_en: Smartphones have become so commonplace that we hardly notice them anymore.
example_zh: 智能手机已经如此普遍，以至于我们几乎不再注意它们。
note: 指‘到处都能见到的’，引申为‘平凡、司空见惯’

example_en: A mere glance was enough for him to recognize her.
example_zh: 仅仅一眼就足够他认出她了。

example_en: The garden adjoins the house, so you can step outside directly from the kitchen.
example_zh: 花园毗邻房子，所以你可以直接从厨房走到外面。
note: adjoin = ad- (向) + join (连接) → 挨着、毗邻

example_en: The full moon illuminated the entire valley.
example_zh: 满月照亮了整个山谷。
note: illuminate = in- (强化) + lumin (光) → 使……发光、照亮

example_en: The microscope uses optical lenses to magnify tiny objects.
example_zh: 显微镜使用光学透镜来放大微小物体。
note: opt 源自希腊语 optos，意为‘可见的’；optical 指与视觉或光有关的

example_en: Eggs and beans are excellent sources of protein.
example_zh: 鸡蛋和豆类是优质的蛋白质来源。
note: protein 源自希腊语 protos（第一），因被认为是生命的基本物质

example_en: The castle is a fine example of medieval architecture.
example_zh: 这座城堡是中世纪建筑的典型代表。
root: medi(中间) + ev(时代) + -al(形容词后缀)
note: medieval = medi- (中间) + ev- (时代，来自 aevum) → 指古典与现代之间的时期

example_en: She pursued perfection in every detail of her performance.
example_zh: 她在表演的每一个细节中都追求完美。
note: perfection 由 perfect（拉丁语 perficere，完成）+ -ion 构成，表示‘完成状态’

example_en: This new software has wide applications in medical diagnosis.
example_zh: 这款新软件在医疗诊断方面有广泛的应用。
note: application 来自 apply（施加）+ -ion，引申为‘实际使用、运用’

example_en: The Nile River is often called the cradle of ancient Egyptian civilization.
example_zh: 尼罗河常被称为古埃及文明的摇篮。

example_en: We must confront the challenges of climate change head-on.
example_zh: 我们必须直面气候变化带来的挑战。
note: confront = con- (共同) + front (前面) → 面对面地遇到，引申为‘直面、应对’

example_en: He tends to exaggerate his achievements.
example_zh: 他总是倾向于夸大自己的成就。
note: 拉丁语aggravare‘使更重’，引申为‘夸大’

example_en: The glass shattered into pieces when it hit the floor.
example_zh: 玻璃掉到地上时碎成了碎片。

example_en: Please attach the document to your email.
example_zh: 请将文件附加到您的邮件中。

example_en: This is the third book in the series.
example_zh: 这是该系列的第三本书。

example_en: She has a fair complexion and freckles.
example_zh: 她肤色白皙，带有雀斑。
note: 原指‘编织在一起’，引申为‘面部肤色’

example_en: Water is a vital substance for life.
example_zh: 水是生命所必需的物质。
note: 拉丁语substare‘站在下面’，引申为‘实体、物质’

example_en: We must do our utmost to help them.
example_zh: 我们必须尽最大努力帮助他们。
note: 合成词，意为‘超过一切的’

example_en: Notwithstanding the rain, we went hiking.
example_zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是去徒步了。

example_en: The apartment has been vacant for months.
example_zh: 这套公寓已经空置了几个月。

example_en: She pursued an academic career in physics.
example_zh: 她在物理学领域追求学术生涯。
note: 源自希腊Akademos，柏拉图讲学地

example_en: Many African countries were once colonial territories.
example_zh: 许多非洲国家曾是殖民领土。

example_en: He makes an occasional visit to his hometown.
example_zh: 他偶尔回家乡看望。
note: 拉丁语occidere‘落下’→‘发生’→‘偶尔发生’

example_en: Poverty remains a serious issue in developing nations.
example_zh: 贫困仍是发展中国家的严重问题。

example_en: The scandal caused public outrage across the country.
example_zh: 这起丑闻引发了全国范围的公众愤怒。

example_en: The fabric has a soft and smooth texture.
example_zh: 这种面料手感柔软光滑。

example_en: Kitchen appliances like blenders and toasters are essential.
example_zh: 厨房电器如搅拌机和烤面包机是必需品。
note: 拉丁语applicare‘应用’→‘应用的工具’

example_en: Dark clouds threaten to ruin our picnic.
example_zh: 乌云密布，威胁要毁掉我们的野餐。

example_en: Please concentrate on your studies during exam week.
example_zh: 考试周请专心学习。

example_en: The discovery was a revelation that changed everything.
example_zh: 这一发现是一个启示，彻底改变了everything。
note: 拉丁语revelare‘揭开帷幕’→‘揭示真相’

example_en: She devotes two hours every day to practicing piano.
example_zh: 她每天花两个小时练习钢琴。
note: 拉丁语devovere‘许下誓愿’→‘全心投入’

example_en: The car remained stationary at the red light.
example_zh: 汽车在红灯处保持静止。

example_en: He pressed the pedal to accelerate the car.
example_zh: 他踩下油门踏板以加速汽车。
note: 拉丁语pes, pedis‘脚’→‘用脚操作的’

example_en: This is the original manuscript, not a copy.
example_zh: 这是原始手稿，不是复印件。
note: 拉丁语oriri‘升起’→‘起源’→‘原始的’

example_en: She looked radiant in her wedding dress.
example_zh: 她穿着婚纱时光彩夺目。
note: 拉丁语radius‘半径、光线’→‘发光的’

example_en: The main criterion for admission is academic excellence.
example_zh: 录取的主要标准是学术优秀。
note: 希腊语kriterion‘判断标准’→‘判断依据’

example_en: She grinned when she heard the good news.
example_zh: 她听到好消息时咧嘴笑了。

example_en: His response to the question was quick and thoughtful.
example_zh: 他对这个问题的反应既快速又深思熟虑。
note: 拉丁语 spondere 意为“承诺”，response 原指“承诺的答复”

example_en: The car bumped over the rough road.
example_zh: 汽车在崎岖的道路上颠簸前行。

example_en: The test results confirmed the doctor’s diagnosis.
example_zh: 检测结果证实了医生的诊断。
note: con- 加强意义，firm 表示“坚定”，共同意为“使坚定不移”→确认

example_en: He rapped on the door to get attention.
example_zh: 他敲门引起注意。

example_en: The sudden noise startled the cat.
example_zh: 突如其来的噪音吓了一跳的猫。

example_en: High cholesterol increases the risk of heart disease.
example_zh: 高胆固醇会增加心脏病的风险。
note: chole- 指胆，sterol 为固醇类化合物，合成“胆固醇”

example_en: They breed horses for racing.
example_zh: 他们培育马用于赛马。

example_en: She wore an exotic dress with bright patterns.
example_zh: 她穿了一件带有鲜艳图案的异国风格连衣裙。
note: ex- 表示“出”，otic 源自希腊语 “外来的”，意为“来自外部的”→异国的

example_en: The two companies decided to merge next year.
example_zh: 两家公司决定明年合并。
note: 拉丁语 mergere 意为“沉没、融入”，引申为“合并”

example_en: After hours of discussion, they reached a consensus.
example_zh: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了共识。
note: con- 表示共同，sensus 感觉 → “共同感觉”→共识

example_en: Please put the extra information in brackets.
example_zh: 请把额外信息放在括号里。

example_en: Smoking jeopardizes your health.
example_zh: 吸烟危害你的健康。
note: jeopardy 源自古法语 “游戏中的风险”，后泛指危险，加 -ize 形成动词

example_en: They aired a commercial during the Super Bowl.
example_zh: 他们在超级碗期间播放了一则广告。
note: commerce 意为商业，-ial 形成形容词，表示“与商业相关的”

example_en: The ceremony will commence at 10 a.m.
example_zh: 仪式将于上午10点开始。
note: com- 加强意义，mence 源自拉丁语 initiare（开始），commence 为强化形式

example_en: The teacher placed emphasis on correct pronunciation.
example_zh: 老师强调了正确发音的重要性。
note: em- 表示进入，phasis 源自希腊语 phanai（说话），意为“突出说话”→强调

example_en: Lying is morally wrong.
example_zh: 说谎在道德上是错误的。
note: 拉丁语 mos 意为习俗、道德，-al 形成形容词，表示“与道德相关的”

example_en: He used a wedge to keep the door open.
example_zh: 他用楔子把门撑开。

example_en: She bought a first-aid kit for camping.
example_zh: 她为露营买了一个急救包。

example_en: Children often imitate their parents' behavior.
example_zh: 孩子们常常模仿父母的行为。
note: im- 为进入强化，imitari 拉丁语动词意为“模仿”，合成“进入模仿状态”→模仿

example_en: GPS has made car navigation much easier.
example_zh: GPS 使汽车导航变得much更容易。
note: navis 拉丁语意为“船”，-ation 形成名词，表示“航行行为”→导航

example_en: That was a weird dream I had last night.
example_zh: 那是我昨晚做的一个奇怪的梦。

example_en: The war was brutal and left many casualties.
example_zh: 战争残酷无比，造成了大量伤亡。
note: 拉丁语 brutus 原指“沉重的、钝的”，引申为“粗野的、残忍的”，-al 形成形容词

example_en: He remained sober after the party.
example_zh: 派对结束后他仍然保持清醒。

example_en: The car needs more fuel to reach the destination.
example_zh: 汽车需要更多燃料才能到达目的地。

example_en: She engages in volunteer work every weekend.
example_zh: 她每个周末都参加志愿者工作。
note: 原指作抵押，引申为投入、从事

example_en: A red light signifies danger.
example_zh: 红灯表示危险。
note: 通过标记来表示某种意义

example_en: Please ventilate the room before sleeping.
example_zh: 睡觉前请先给房间通风。
note: 让空气流动，比喻发表意见

example_en: Kick the bucket is an idiom meaning 'to die'.
example_zh: Kick the bucket 是一个习语，意思是“死去”。
note: 特有的表达方式，非直译意义

example_en: The Maasai tribe lives in Kenya and Tanzania.
example_zh: 马赛部落居住在肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚。

example_en: Poachers kill elephants for their ivory tusks.
example_zh: 偷猎者为了象牙而杀害大象。

example_en: He has an acute sense of hearing.
example_zh: 他听觉非常敏锐。
note: 尖锐的，引申为敏锐或严重的

example_en: The agent was sent to spy on enemy movements.
example_zh: 特工被派去侦察敌人的行动。

example_en: The company plans to upgrade its software next month.
example_zh: 公司计划下个月升级其软件。

example_en: We anticipated heavy traffic and left early.
example_zh: 我们预料到会有严重交通，于是提前出发。
note: 提前拿到手，即预期或预防

example_en: The court deemed the evidence inadmissible.
example_zh: 法院认为该证据不可采纳。

example_en: The city is undergoing a cultural renaissance.
example_zh: 这座城市正经历一场文化复兴。
note: 再次出生，比喻文化或活力的复苏

example_en: The flood had disastrous effects on the village.
example_zh: 洪水对村庄造成了灾难性的影响。
root: dis-(不良的) + astro(星) + -ous(形容词后缀)
note: 原指星象不佳，引申为极其不吉利

example_en: The bakery produces fresh bread in batches every morning.
example_zh: 面包店每天早上分批生产新鲜面包。

example_en: They believe that power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely — a truly evil idea.
example_zh: 他们认为权力会腐化人，绝对的权力会绝对腐化人——这是一个真正邪恶的想法。

example_en: The sun radiates heat and light.
example_zh: 太阳辐射出热量和光。
note: 发出射线或能量，比喻散发魅力等

example_en: The doctor reassured the patient that the test results were normal.
example_zh: 医生安慰患者说检查结果正常。
note: 再次让人确信，即消除担忧

example_en: Scientists are still searching for a solution to climate change.
example_zh: 科学家们仍在寻找应对气候变化的解决方案。
note: 将问题‘松开’即解开，比喻找到答案

example_en: Many immigrants come to China seeking better job opportunities.
example_zh: 许多移民来到中国寻找更好的工作机会。

example_en: The news coverage of the earthquake was extensive.
example_zh: 对地震的新闻报道非常广泛。
note: 媒体对事件的报道范围或深度

example_en: Gender equality is a fundamental human right.
example_zh: 性别平等是一项基本人权。
note: 状态或质量：被视为相等

example_en: The instructions were too complex for beginners to follow.
example_zh: 说明对初学者来说太复杂了，难以理解。
note: 多部分交织在一起，难以理清

example_en: The chemist poured the liquid into a glass flask.
example_zh: 化学家把液体倒入玻璃烧瓶中。

example_en: An angry mob gathered outside the courthouse.
example_zh: 一群愤怒的暴民聚集在法院外。

example_en: She used a sponge to wipe the kitchen counter.
example_zh: 她用海绵擦了厨房台面。

example_en: The prisoner was released after serving his sentence.
example_zh: 服刑结束后，囚犯被释放。
note: re-表示回到原状态，lease原指租赁，引申为‘放回’→释放

example_en: The frequency of earthquakes in this region has increased.
example_zh: 该地区地震的频率有所增加。
note: frequent表示频繁出现，-cy构成名词，表示‘频繁程度’→频率

example_en: The government plans to reclaim the wasteland for farming.
example_zh: 政府计划将荒地收回用于农耕。
note: re-表示回到原状态，claim原指宣称权利，引申为‘夺回’→收回

example_en: Protesters occupied the city square for three days.
example_zh: 抗议者占据了城市广场三天。
note: ob-强化，cup源自拉丁语capere‘拿取’，引申为‘拿取并保持’→占据

example_en: It was a fitting tribute to her lifelong dedication.
example_zh: 这是对她毕生奉献的恰当致敬。
note: fit表示‘合适’，-ing形成形容词，表示‘具备…性质的’→合适的

example_en: The novelty of the gadget wore off after a week.
example_zh: 这个小装置的新奇感一周后就消失了。
note: novel表示‘新的’，-ty构成抽象名词，表示‘新奇的状态’→新奇

example_en: Her advice was invaluable during the crisis.
example_zh: 危机时期，她的建议无价。
note: in-否定，value表示价值，-able形成形容词，意为‘无法估量的价值’→无价的

example_en: The government tried to appease the protesters with concessions.
example_zh: 政府试图通过让步来安抚抗议者。
note: a-表示向…方向，peace指和平，动词化意为‘使…和平’→安抚

example_en: Proper disposal of waste is essential for environmental protection.
example_zh: 正确处理废物对环境保护至关重要。
root: dis-(分开) + pose(放置) + -al(名词后缀)
note: dis-表示分开，pose原指放置，-al形成名词，引申为‘分开放置’→处理废弃物

example_en: Mobile phones have revolutionized communication.
example_zh: 移动手机彻底改变了通信方式。
note: mov源自拉丁语movere‘移动’，-ile形成形容词，表示‘具备移动性的’→移动的

example_en: The view from the mountain top was absolutely fantastic.
example_zh: 山顶的景色绝对极好。
note: fantasy指幻想，-ic形成形容词，意为‘如幻想般的’→引申为极好、惊艳的

example_en: The plague devastated the medieval population.
example_zh: 瘟疫毁灭了中世纪的人口。
note: plag源自拉丁语plagare‘击打’，引申为‘造成毁灭性打击’→灾祸、瘟疫

example_en: After much debate, he finally conceded that she was right.
example_zh: 经过激烈辩论，他终于承认她是对的。
note: con-强化，ced源自拉丁语cedere‘走’，引申为‘让步’→承认对方正确

example_en: The city installed more crosswalks to protect pedestrians.
example_zh: 城市增设了更多人行横道以保护行人。
note: ped源自拉丁语pes‘脚’，estrian形成名词，表示‘行走的人’→行人

example_en: The building was engulfed in a fierce blaze.
example_zh: 大楼被烈火吞噬。
note: blaze源自古法语blaser‘燃烧’，直接表示‘猛烈的火焰’→烈火

example_en: The meeting concluded with a vote on the new policy.
example_zh: 会议以对新政策的投票结束。
note: con-强化，clud源自拉丁语claudere‘关闭’，引申为‘完全关闭’→结束

example_en: Please don't litter the park with plastic bottles.
example_zh: 请不要在公园里乱扔塑料瓶。
note: lit源自古英语littor‘小东西’，-ter形成名词，指散落的小碎片→垃圾

example_en: Military discipline is essential for battlefield success.
example_zh: 军纪对战场成功至关重要。
root: dis-(分开) + cip(拿取) + -line(名词后缀)
note: dis-表示分开，cip源自拉丁语capere‘拿取’，-line形成名词，引申为‘规范行为’→纪律

example_en: He was merely a clerk, not a manager.
example_zh: 他只是一个职员，不是经理。
note: mere表示‘仅仅的’，-ly形成副词，意为‘仅仅’→仅仅

example_en: The government proposed radical reforms to the tax system.
example_zh: 政府提出了对税制的根本性改革。
note: radix源自拉丁语‘根’，-al形成形容词，表示‘与根有关的’→引申为根本的、彻底的

example_en: Smoking is a dangerous vice that harms health.
example_zh: 吸烟是一种危害健康的恶习。
note: vit源自拉丁语vita‘生命’，vice原指‘生命力’，后转义为‘败坏品德的习惯’→恶习

example_en: The court upheld the constitutionality of the law.
example_zh: 法院维持了该法律的合宪性。
note: up-表示向上，hold指拿住，引申为‘向上托住’→维持、支持

example_en: A multitude of fans gathered outside the stadium.
example_zh: 众多球迷聚集在体育场外。
note: multi-表示许多，tud源自拉丁语tutus‘状态’，-e形成名词，表示‘众多状态’→众多

example_en: The accident crippled him for life.
example_zh: 事故导致他终身残疾。
note: crip源自古英语crypple‘弯曲的’，-le形成动词，表示‘使…弯曲失能’→致残

example_en: The student was expelled for cheating on the exam.
example_zh: 该学生因考试作弊被开除。
note: e-表示向外，pel源自拉丁语pellere‘推动’，引申为‘向外推’→驱逐、开除

example_en: The appendix contains additional data and references.
example_zh: 附录包含额外的数据和参考文献。
note: 表示'悬挂在主体后的部分'，如书籍附录

example_en: We strolled through the park on a sunny afternoon.
example_zh: 我们在阳光明媚的下午漫步穿过公园。

example_en: Students need to memorize vocabulary for the exam.
example_zh: 学生需要为考试记忆词汇。
note: 通过'memor'（记住）构成动词，意为‘使记住’

example_en: Ethnic minorities often face social challenges.
example_zh: 少数民族常面临社会挑战。
note: 表示'较小的部分'，指人数或比例较少的群体

example_en: The bridge has a span of 500 meters.
example_zh: 这座桥的跨度为500米。

example_en: He seemed indifferent to the news of his promotion.
example_zh: 他对晋升的消息似乎漠不关心。
root: in-(不) + differ(不同) + -ent(形容词后缀)
note: 不产生差异 → 不关心，无偏好

example_en: Please follow the safety procedure when operating the machine.
example_zh: 操作机器时请遵守安全程序。
note: 向前走的步骤 → 按顺序进行的步骤或流程

example_en: The police detained the suspect for questioning.
example_zh: 警方扣留嫌疑人以便审问。
note: 完全拿住 → 拘留，不让离开

example_en: The wind lashed the trees during the storm.
example_zh: 暴风雨中，狂风鞭打着树木。

example_en: Her speech expressed deep sentiment for her hometown.
example_zh: 她的演讲表达了对家乡深深的情感。
note: 感受 → 情感、情绪、倾向

example_en: He tied the package with a strong cord.
example_zh: 他用一根结实的绳子捆住了包裹。

example_en: She has a preference for tea over coffee.
example_zh: 她更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
note: 先带走 → 优先选择，倾向于某物

example_en: The employee handbook outlines company policies.
example_zh: 员工手册列明了公司政策。
note: 手边的书 → 随身携带的参考书籍

example_en: The transmission of data was interrupted by a power surge.
example_zh: 数据传输因电压突增而中断。
note: 送过去 → 传递、传输信号或能量

example_en: The committee consists of five members from different departments.
example_zh: 委员会由来自不同部门的五名成员组成。
note: 一起站立 → 由…构成，存在于某种状态中

example_en: The diver spotted a shark circling near the reef.
example_zh: 潜水员发现一条鲨鱼在礁石附近游动。

example_en: The flood ruined the entire harvest.
example_zh: 洪水毁掉了整季的收成。

example_en: Children should behave well in public places.
example_zh: 孩子们在公共场合应表现良好。
note: 使有某种举止 → 表现出某种行为

example_en: The prince ascended the throne after his father's death.
example_zh: 父亲去世后，王子继承了王位。

example_en: She played an instrumental role in organizing the event.
example_zh: 她在组织此次活动中发挥了关键作用。
note: 像工具一样有用 → 起关键作用的，必不可少的

example_en: Only citizens over 18 are eligible to vote.
example_zh: 只有年满18岁的公民才有投票资格。
note: 能被选出 → 符合条件，具备资格

example_en: The meeting ended abruptly due to a power outage.
example_zh: 会议因停电而突然结束。
note: 离开断裂 → 意外中断，突然发生

example_en: Under no circumstance should you share your password.
example_zh: 无论如何，你都不应该分享你的密码。
note: 周围站立的状态 → 所处的情境或条件

example_en: Strong emotions can cloud rational judgment.
example_zh: 强烈的情绪可能会模糊理性判断。
note: 动出来的感觉 → 内心激动产生的感受

example_en: His rude comment caused offense to everyone in the room.
example_zh: 他粗鲁的评论让房间里的每个人都感到被冒犯。
note: 原指击打，引申为冒犯他人

example_en: The city is on the verge of economic collapse.
example_zh: 这座城市正濒临经济崩溃的边缘。
note: 指事物转向或接近某状态的边界

example_en: The room was dimly lit by a single bulb.
example_zh: 房间只有一盏灯，光线很昏暗。

example_en: The children mocked the new student for his accent.
example_zh: 孩子们嘲笑新同学的口音。
note: 通过模仿他人来嘲讽或取笑

example_en: Police asked for his identification at the checkpoint.
example_zh: 警察在检查点要求他出示身份证明。
note: 确认某人或物的同一性

example_en: Honesty is considered a cardinal virtue.
example_zh: 诚实被视为基本美德之一。
note: 拉丁语vir指男子，引申为道德品质

example_en: Natural resources are finite and must be used wisely.
example_zh: 自然资源是有限的，必须明智使用。

example_en: He gave a blunt answer that hurt her feelings.
example_zh: 他直率地回答了问题，伤了她的感情。

example_en: The economy entered a downward spiral after the crisis.
example_zh: 危机后，经济进入了下降螺旋。
note: 古希腊认为螺旋像呼吸的曲线

example_en: After the illness, she felt too feeble to walk.
example_zh: 生病后，她感到太虚弱而无法行走。
note: 拉丁语febris（发热），引申为无力

example_en: She made tremendous progress in her studies this year.
example_zh: 她今年在学习上取得了巨大进步。
note: 原指使人颤抖的巨大，引申为极其巨大

example_en: The final match is Team A versus Team B.
example_zh: 决赛是A队对抗B队。
note: 拉丁语versus，意为“转向……”，用于对抗

example_en: Many believe the sunset over the ocean is a divine sight.
example_zh: 许多人相信海上日落是神圣的景象。

example_en: He relaxed in a hot tub after a long day.
example_zh: 一天辛苦后，他泡在热水浴缸里放松。
